telemetry.name: AVS_SS_STRING_STATE
telemetry.description: Reports the string state of this ECE.

telemetry.name: AVS_XS_STRING_STATE
telemetry.description: Reports the string state of the other ECE.

telemetry.name: AVS_XS_FILE_RECV_IN_PROGRESS
telemetry.description: Reports if Prime string is receiving a copy of a specified file from the Online string.

telemetry.name: AVS_XS_FILE_SEND_IN_PROGRESS
telemetry.description: Reports if Prime string is sending a copy of a specified file to the FSW on the Online string.

telemetry.name: AVS_XS_TIME_ESTABLISHED
telemetry.description: Tells whether the cross string has an established time.

telemetry.name: AVS_SS_STRING_ID
telemetry.description: The String ID, referring to the physical ECE (A or B). This is read from the EIO.

telemetry.name: AVS_EIO_STRING_STATUS_REGISTER
telemetry.description: This register monitors the status of the redundancy management status bits. Bit definitions starting with "LB" are status bits for the Loop Back signals that were outputted from the EIO. Bits starting with "CSR" are the status bits for the Cross String EIO. Bits starting with "SW" are set by the FSW.

telemetry.name: AVS_EMEM_STRING_STATUS_REGISTER
telemetry.description: This register uses bits 0-15 to monitor the status of the redundancy management status bits. Bit definitions starting with "LB" are status bits for the Loop Back signals that were outputted from the EMEM.

telemetry.name: AVS_XS_CPU_UTILIZATION
telemetry.description: Reports the cross string CPU utilization as a percentage.

telemetry.name: AVS_XS_CPU_UTILIZATION_HWM
telemetry.description: Reports the cross string's overall CPU Utilization high-water mark as percentage.

telemetry.name: AVS_XS_LAST_SUCCESS_CMD_OPCODE
telemetry.description: Reports the last successfully completed command's opcode executed by the cross string.

telemetry.name: AVS_XS_LAST_FAILED_CMD_OPCODE
telemetry.description: Reports the last failed command's opcode sent to the cross string.

telemetry.name: AVS_XS_TOTAL_WARNING_LOW_EVRS
telemetry.description: Reports the total number of the warning low EVRs on the cross string.

telemetry.name: AVS_XS_LAST_WARNING_LOW_EVR_ID
telemetry.description: Reports the ID of the last EVR warning low on the cross string.

telemetry.name: AVS_XS_SCLK_SECONDS
telemetry.description: The SCLK seconds reported by the Online ECE.

telemetry.name: AVS_XS_EIO_MEASURED_DRIFT
telemetry.description: Measures the time drift of the cross string with respect to the Prime string from the EIO board. SCTDC_REG

telemetry.name: AVS_XS_EIO_DRIFT_ADJUSTMENT_REG
telemetry.description: Time adjustment register on the Online RCE - SCTAR_REG

telemetry.name: AVS_XS_EMEM_PCI_DRIFT
telemetry.description: EMEM PCI drift control register: TIMING_DRIFT_T

telemetry.name: AVS_XS_RESET_SOURCE_REGISTER
telemetry.description: Displays the state of the cross string EIO reset source register, which includes the reset source and number of PCI resets.

telemetry.name: AVS_XS_CRC_NONVOL_STATE
telemetry.description: State of cross-string non-volatile CRCs (from Online String Health Report).

telemetry.name: AVS_XS_CRC_VOL_STATE
telemetry.description: State of cross-string volatile CRCs (from Online String Health Report).

telemetry.name: AVS_SS_PIDS_STATE_31_0
telemetry.description: State of the self-string ECE PIDs (from SFC), 31:0.

telemetry.name: AVS_SS_PIDS_STATE_63_32
telemetry.description: State of the self-string ECE PIDs (from SFC), 63:32.

telemetry.name: AVS_XS_PIDS_STATE_0_31
telemetry.description: State of the cross-string ECE PIDs (from Online String Health Report), 0-31.

telemetry.name: AVS_XS_PIDS_STATE_32_63
telemetry.description: State of the cross-string ECE PIDs (from Online String Health Report), 32-63.

telemetry.name: AVS_EIO_RESET_REGISTER
telemetry.description: Displays the state of the EIO's reset register. Note that during FSW initialization, the reset causes are reported in an EVR before they are cleared. This register additionally reports the PCI reset counter and an overflow indication.

telemetry.name: AVS_SS_VOLATILE_CRC_STATE
telemetry.description: State of all the volatile CRCs on the self-string ECE

telemetry.name: AVS_SS_VOLATILE_CRC_MASKS
telemetry.description: State of all the volatile CRC masks on the self-string ECE. If a bit is 1, the corresponding CRC is considered unmasked and can be modified by FSW.

telemetry.name: AVS_SS_NON_VOLATILE_CRC_STATE
telemetry.description: State of all the non-volatile CRCs on the self-string ECE

telemetry.name: AVS_SS_NON_VOLATILE_CRC_MASKS
telemetry.description: State of all the non-volatile CRC masks on the self-string ECE. If a bit is 1, the corresponding CRC is considered unmasked and can be modified by FSW.

telemetry.name: AVS_BOOT_TYPE
telemetry.description:
Boot type determines how the system was initialized. The Boot types are: POR Boot - the ECE was initially powered off Cold Boot - the ECE was initially powered on, but the DDR2 was reset Cool Boot - the ECE was initially powered on, but the DDR2 was not reset (so some data could be recovered)
Determination of boot type uses the following registers bits: POR_boot if any of the following are set: a - EIO RSTSR_REG - bit 0 (por_rst) b - RTAX CAR - bit 0 (SFC Power-On Reset) Else Cold_boot if any of the following are set: a - RTAX CAR - bit 9 (Configuration Error Status) b - RTAX CAR - bit 8 (V5 Program Pin Override) c - RTAX CAR - bit 4 (EMC Watchdog Expired) d - RTAX CAR - bit 3 (SW_INIT_V7_RST Asserted) e - RTAX CAR - bit 1 (SW_INIT_RST Asserted) f - No register reset indicators (EIO RSTSR_REG bits 0-7 or RTAX CAR bits 0-9) Else Cool_boot // Expect the following indicators: a - EIO RSTSR_REG bits 7, 6, 5, 4, 2, 1 b - RTAX CAR bits 6, 5

telemetry.name: AVS_BDS_OPERATIONAL_MODE
telemetry.description:
BDS Operational modes consist of:
UNKNOWN: State while FSW initializes where the state of the BDS H/W is unknown.
UART_HS_ONLY: BDS NAND, BDSM, DDR2, and BDS V5 are all powered off. LRC is on. No instrument recording to BDS. UART instrument H&S is available but no SpW instrument H&S. UART instruments are command-able, but no SpW instrument commanding.
NO_SPW_RECORDING: LRC, BDS NAND, BDSM, DDR2, and BDS V5 are all powered on, but no SpW instrument data is recorded to BDS. UART recording is still available. H&S for all instruments is available. All instruments are command-able.
FULL_OPERATIONAL: LRC, BDS NAND, BDSM, DDR2, and BDS V5 are all powered on. All instrument data is recorded, H&S for all instruments is available and all instruments are command-able.

telemetry.name: AVS_EMEM_SRAM_0_UNCORR_ERROR_COUNT
telemetry.description: The cumulative count of the number uncorrectable errors in EMEM SRAM. From EME register SRAM_0_ECC_UERR_T bits 15:0 uerr_cnt. This counter is cleared on every reset.

telemetry.name: AVS_EMEM_SRAM_0_CORR_ERROR_COUNT
telemetry.description: The cumulative count of the number correctable errors in EMEM SRAM. Reflects EMEM register SRAM_0_ECC_CERR_T bits 15:0 cerr_cnt. This counter is cleared on every reset.

telemetry.name: AVS_XS_BOOT_PROGRESS_DISCRETES

telemetry.name: AVS_EMEM_FFB_PARITY_ERROR_COUNT
telemetry.description: EMEM's FPGA-to-FPGA count of receive and transmit parity errors from FFB_ESCR3_T: 7:4 = tx_perr_cnt 3:0 = rx_perr_cnt

telemetry.name: AVS_EMEM_SRAM_1_UNCORR_ERROR_COUNT
telemetry.description: The cumulative count of the number uncorrectable errors in EMEM SRAM. From EME register SRAM_1_ECC_UERR_T bits 15:0 uerr_cnt. This counter is cleared on every reset.

telemetry.name: AVS_EMEM_SRAM_1_CORR_ERROR_COUNT
telemetry.description: The cumulative count of the number correctable errors in EMEM SRAM. Reflects EMEM register SRAM_1_ECC_CERR_T bits 15:0 cerr_cnt. This counter is cleared on every reset.

telemetry.name: AVS_XS_ONLINE_SUBSTATE
telemetry.description: Reports the substate of the online string via the online health report

telemetry.name: AVS_SUROM_DDR2_TEST_RECOVERABLE_MAP_DIFF
telemetry.description: SUROM sets this true if the checksum of the bad page map from the beginning through the end of recoverable memory has changed since the last boot. This will always be true for a POR or Cold Boot.

telemetry.name: AVS_EMEM_NAND_A_CORR_ERROR_COUNT
telemetry.description: The count of the number correctable errors in EMEM NAND DMR Array A.

telemetry.name: AVS_EMEM_NAND_B_CORR_ERROR_COUNT
telemetry.description: The count of the number correctable errors in EMEM NAND DMR array B.

telemetry.name: AVS_EMEM_NAND_A_UNCORR_ERROR_COUNT
telemetry.description: The count of the number uncorrectable errors in EMEM NAND DMR array A

telemetry.name: AVS_EMEM_NAND_B_UNCORR_ERROR_COUNT
telemetry.description: The count of the number uncorrectable errors in EMEM NAND DMR array B

telemetry.name: AVS_EMEM_NAND_DMR_UNCORR_ERROR_COUNT

telemetry.name: AVS_EMEM_NAND_DMR_DATA_MISCOMP_COUNT
telemetry.description: Track the number of DMR miscompares

telemetry.name: AVS_EMEM_SRAM_0_FIRST_UNCORR_ERROR_ADDR

telemetry.name: AVS_EMEM_SRAM_1_FIRST_UNCORR_ERROR_ADDR

telemetry.name: AVS_EMEM_SRAM_0_LAST_UNCORR_ERROR_ADDR
telemetry.description: This is the address of the last SRAM 0 uncorrectable error

telemetry.name: AVS_EMEM_SRAM_1_LAST_UNCORR_ERROR_ADDR
telemetry.description: This is the address of the last SRAM 1 uncorrectable error

telemetry.name: AVS_EMEM_SRAM_0_FIRST_CORR_ERROR_ADDR
telemetry.description: This is the address of the first SRAM 0 correctable error

telemetry.name: AVS_EMEM_SRAM_1_FIRST_CORR_ERROR_ADDR
telemetry.description: This is the address of the first SRAM 1 correctable error

telemetry.name: AVS_EMEM_SRAM_0_LAST_CORR_ERROR_ADDR
telemetry.description: This is the address of the last SRAM 0 correctable error

telemetry.name: AVS_EMEM_SRAM_1_LAST_CORR_ERROR_ADDR
telemetry.description: This is the address of the last SRAM 1 correctable error

telemetry.name: AVS_EMEM_MRAM_PERSIST_ERR_CNT
telemetry.description: Number of persistent error corrected by the MRAM devices

telemetry.name: AVS_EMEM_MRAM_TOTAL_ERR_CNT
telemetry.description: Total number of error corrected by the MRAM devices (transient and persistent)

telemetry.name: AVS_EMEM_MRAM_FIRST_ERR_ADDR
telemetry.description: Address of the first error reported by any MRAM device

telemetry.name: AVS_EMEM_MRAM_LAST_ERR_ADDR
telemetry.description: Address of the last/most recent error reported by any MRAM device

telemetry.name: AVS_ZOMBIE_SUBSTATE
telemetry.description: If true, this string is in Zombie mode.

telemetry.name: AVS_TZ_AND_TEST_MODE_CONNECTION_STATUS_REGISTER

telemetry.name: AVS_EIO_BC_CORR_ERROR_COUNT
telemetry.description: The cumulative count of the number correctable errors in EIO BC RAM. This counter is cleared on every reset. This is reported by H/W in register EDACERS_REG.

telemetry.name: AVS_EIO_BC_UNCORR_ERROR_COUNT
telemetry.description: The count of the number uncorrectable errors in EIO BC RAM. This is reported by H/W in register EDACERS_REG.

telemetry.name: AVS_EIO_BC_RAM_EDAC_ERROR_ADDR
telemetry.description: The address of the first uncorrectable error (DBE) or the last correctable error (SBE). EDACADR_REG

telemetry.name: AVS_EIO_BC_RAM_ERROR_ADDR
telemetry.description: Address of the physical address of the last RAM access that caused an EDAC error. This channel is reporting register EDACBCADR_REG. This is the address for the single bit or double bit error address location.

telemetry.name: AVS_BDS_DDR2_LAST_CORR_ERROR_ADDR
telemetry.description: BDS HRC DDR Correctable Last Error Address Register. Correctable bit error last address. Last address for all read correctable bit errors including scrub read and nominal DDR read. Address is absolute value 0 - ddr top. Does not report MBIST ECC error. HRC section 3.11.8.12 Offset: 0x00d4. Register address 0xC0EDA0D4.

telemetry.name: AVS_BDS_DDR2_FIRST_UNCORR_ERROR_ADDR
telemetry.description: BDS HRC DDR Uncorrectable First Error Address Register. Uncorrectable bit error first address. First address set for all read uncorrectable bit errors including scrub read and nominal DDR read. Address is absolute value 0 - ddr top. Does not report MBIST ECC error. HRC section 3.11.8.13, Offset: 0x00d8. Register address 0xC0EDA0D4

telemetry.name: AVS_SFC_DDR2_EXPECTED_UNCOR_ERR_COUNT
telemetry.description: Cumulative count of the expected uncorrectable errors in SFC DDR2. Information from MCTL Interrupt Status register, bits 31:24 and FSW manages the overflow. This counter covers the memory region where multi-bit errors are injected, such that we can monitor if the DDR2 scrubber is correctly working.

telemetry.name: AVS_BDS_CCSDS_TO_DDR2_CACHE_POSITION
telemetry.description: Position where the HRC is buffering up data as it comes in post-fragmentation into BSUs stored in DDR-2.

telemetry.name: AVS_BDS_BSU_TO_NAND_FLUSH_POSITION
telemetry.description: Position of the DDR-2 -> NAND flush logic

telemetry.name: AVS_BDS_NAND_POWER_STATUS
telemetry.description:
Actual status of each of 28 BDSM NAND stacks (using GET_POWER). Map the response as follows:
31 unused 30:24 NAND group 3 stacks [6:0] power good status 23 unused 22:16 NAND group 2 stacks [6:0] power good status 15 unused 14:8 NAND group 1 stacks [6:0] power good status 7 unused 6:0 NAND group 0 stacks [6:0] power good status
Note on PT hardware there is no individual stack control. These bits should still be reported, TBD if the PT reports correct power state (all bits ON or OFF). Will update Helix description once we know how the PT hardware works.
Sample at TBD Hz (FSW discretion, any rate 1Hz or faster is fine)

telemetry.name: AVS_EMEM_NAND_POWER_STATUS
telemetry.description:
Just return the 32-bit NAND_POWER register contents
Bit 5 = nand_b_power_good Bit 1 = nand_a_power_good

telemetry.name: AVS_BDS_HRC_STC_REGISTER_MASP
telemetry.description: Spacewire 0-7 TLM Count (STC) Register (offset 0x028). SpaceWire Telemetry Count is a 23-bit dword count (4 bytes) of received telemetry routed only to LRC OSRAM, i.e., it counts only health & status telemetry packets. The count includes packets discarded due to length violations.

telemetry.name: AVS_SLINKY_SYNC_ADJUSTMENT
telemetry.description: Slinky sync adjusts the FSW Scheduler to sync with the RTI (from EIO). This channel is the value of the adjustment. Raw units are in TBR (time base register) counts. Divide by 16.5 to get microseconds.

telemetry.name: AVS_SFC_V5_MRAM_TOTAL_UCERR
telemetry.description:
Contains the number of uncorrectable errors detected in either MRAM chip on the SFC V5 MRAM. These MRAM chips house the JPL SUROM banks 0 and 1 (MRAM1) and JPL SUROM banks 2 and 3 (MRAM2). This is a direct reflection of the register MRAM Uncorrectable Error Counter Register.
This register is also called "v5-mram-ucorrErrorCount" or "MRAM_UCORR_ERR_CNT - ece.sfc.mram.MRAM_UCORR_ERR_CNT"

telemetry.name: AVS_SFC_V5_MRAM_TOTAL_CERR

This register is also called "v5-mram-corrErrorCount" or "MRAM_CORR_ERR_CNT - ece.sfc.mram.MRAM_CORR_ERR_CNT"

This register is also called "v5-mram-mbeCount1" or "MRAM1_MBE_CNT - ece.sfc.mram.MRAM1_MBE_CNT"

telemetry.name: AVS_SFC_V5_MRAM2_TOTAL_MBE
telemetry.description:
Contains the number of MultiBit errors detected in the MRAM2 chip on the SFC V5 MRAM. The MRAM2 chip houses the JPL SUROM banks 2 and 3. This is a direct reflection of the register MRAM 2 MultiBitError Counter Register.
This register is also called "v5-mram-mbeCount2" or "MRAM2_MBE_CNT - ece.sfc.mram.MRAM2_MBE_CNT"

telemetry.name: AVS_SFC_RTAX_MRAM_TOTAL_UCERR
telemetry.description:

This register is also called "rtax-mram-ucorrErrorCount" or "MRAM_UCORR_ERR_CNT - ece.sfc.mram_rtax.MRAM_UCORR_ERR_CNT"

telemetry.name: AVS_SFC_DDR2_SCRUB_CORR_ERR_ADDR_COUNT
telemetry.description:
Starting at the beginning of each DDR-2 scrub cycle, at 1 Hz, FSW counts the addresses that had a correctable error.
Details - At 1 Hz, check bit 2 (Correctable Error Log Valid) of MCTL.Interrupt_Status. Up to 8 times, increment the count, pop that error off the FIFO (using bit 2 Correctable Error Log Pop of MCTL.Control), check bit Correctable Error Log Valid again, and repeat if it is still set. Pop at most 8 errors per 1 Hz cycle. New errors could be happening as these are being popped off, and potentially this could lead to FSW rate group overrun, hence limiting it to 8 even if there are still errors in the log.
At the end of the scrub cycle, FSW pushes the total count to this channel. (In other words, this channel holds the count of error addresses detected during the last scrub cycle, and will only update about once per hour)

telemetry.name: AVS_SFC_DDR2_SCRUB_VERIFY_FAIL_COUNT
telemetry.description:
Starting at the beginning of each DDR-2 scrub cycle, at 1 Hz, FSW counts the number of times a scrub verify failure was seen. These failures indicate a persistent fault (stuck bit, or SEFI requiring a power cycle)
Details - At 1 Hz, check bit 13 (Scrub Verify Error) of MCTL.Interrupt_Status. If it is set, increment the count, and clear the bit.
At the end of the scrub cycle, FSW pushes the total count to this channel. (In other words, this channel holds the count of scrub verify failures detected during the last scrub cycle, and will only update about once per hour)

telemetry.name: AVS_SS_PID42_750_V5_SCRUB_ERROR
telemetry.description: V5 scrubber error detected. Connected to RTAX CAR Reset and State History Register[9]. This bit is set to a '1' when a configuration memory error from the V5 is detected.

telemetry.name: DDM_FRAMES_TRANS
telemetry.description: The total number of frames send to HW buffers/Transmitted (DMA'd)

telemetry.name: DDM_DROPPED_FRAMES
telemetry.description: This is the calculated dropped frames based on subtracting the frames transmitted from the total number of frames originally in the buffer.

telemetry.name: DDM_DWN_VC1_VCFC
telemetry.description: The last frame count assigned to a VC1 frame

telemetry.name: DDM_NUM_FS_DP_CREATED
telemetry.description: The total number of products which have been added to the data catalog. NOTE: This channel is a U32 and can potentially overflow if more than 4294967295 file system data products are created between resets.

telemetry.name: DDM_NUM_KBYTES_EFS_DP_CREATED
telemetry.description: The total number of kibibytes (bytes/1024) of engineering file system data products created since initialization. Rounded to the nearest kibibyte.

telemetry.name: DDM_NUM_FS_DP_DELETED
telemetry.description: The total number of file system data products which have been deleted from the data catalog since initialization. NOTE: This channel is a U32 and can potentially overflow if more than 4294967295 file system data products are deleted between resets.

telemetry.name: DDM_NUM_KBYTES_EFS_DP_DELETED
telemetry.description: The total volume in kibibytes (bytes/1024) of all engineering file system data products which have been deleted from the data catalog. Rounded to the nearest kibibyte.

telemetry.name: DDM_NUM_DP_SENT
telemetry.description: Total number of data products that are considered sent (i.e. all parts marked sent) that are contained in the catalog. After a reset, this value is repopulated from nonvolatile data product files.

telemetry.name: DDM_NUM_KBYTES_DP_SENT
telemetry.description: Total number of kibibytes (bytes/1024) of data products that are considered sent (i.e. all parts marked SENT) that are contained in the catalog. After a reset, this value is repopulated from nonvolatile data product files. Rounded to the nearest kibibyte.

telemetry.name: DDM_NUM_DP_UNSENT
telemetry.description: Total number of data products that are considered unsent (i.e. at least 1 part is not marked sent) that are contained in the catalog. After a reset, this value is repopulated from nonvolatile data product files.

telemetry.name: DDM_NUM_KBYTES_DP_UNSENT
telemetry.description: Total number of kibibytes (bytes/1024) for data products that are considered unsent (i.e. at least 1 part is not marked SENT) that are contained in the catalog. After a reset, this value is repopulated from nonvolatile data product files. Rounded to the nearest kibibyte.

telemetry.name: DDM_NUM_DP_PARTIAL_SENT
telemetry.description: Total number of data products that are considered partially sent (i.e. some but not all parts marked sent) that are contained in the catalog.

telemetry.name: DDM_DP_NUM_DP_PKTS_SENT
telemetry.description: The number of DP packets which have been sent to DWN_MGR. This value includes MPDU, DPDU, and EPDU packets. It does not persist across resets.

telemetry.name: DDM_NUM_DP_KBYTES_SENT_DWN
telemetry.description: The number of DP kibibytes (bytes/1024) that have been sent to DWN_MGR. This value includes MPDU, DPDU, and EPDU packets. It does not persist across resets. Rounded to the nearest kibibyte.

telemetry.name: DDM_DP_NUM_DP_XACTIONS_COMPLETED
telemetry.description: The number of complete data products that have been packetized and sent to DWN_MGR. This value does not persist across resets.

telemetry.name: DDM_DP_NUM_FILE_OPERATIONS_FAILED
telemetry.description: The number of DP file operations which have failed while packetizing engineering data products. This value does not persist across resets.

telemetry.name: DDM_EFS_DP_MIGRATED_TOTAL_KBYTES
telemetry.description: Number of kibibytes (bytes/1024) of engineering file system data product successfully written to the engineering file system. Rounded to the nearest kibibyte.

telemetry.name: DDM_DP_CREATED_TOTAL_NUM
telemetry.description: Number of data products created in the FSW file system by which have been fully written and closed successfully.

telemetry.name: DDM_DP_FAILED_MIGRATED_TOTAL_BYTES
telemetry.description: Number of data product bytes which have been discarded following a file system or catalog error while migrating data product.

telemetry.name: DDM_DP_FAILED_CREATED_TOTAL_NUM
telemetry.description: Number of data products which encountered a catalog or file system error while in the process of being created in the FSW file system. (These products may not exist, be partial, or be complete depending on when the error was encountered.)

telemetry.name: DDM_PROCESSED_RT_FATAL_EVR_COUNTER

telemetry.name: DDM_DROPPED_RT_FATAL_EVR_COUNTER

telemetry.name: DDM_SLOWEST_RATE_EXE
telemetry.description: This will count up as the TSR rules are being evaluated to assess how the selected TSR set is performing and if every rule in the table is getting evaluated. As FSW evaluates each for in each rate group, it will increment the counter. When the counter reaches 3600 sec then you know that FSW has reached the slowest rate of rule execution. There is no indicator that the last rule at the lowest rate has been evaluated but this should become clear after 1 hour. Everytime the TSR is modified or a new TSR set is applied, this counter resets.

telemetry.name: DDM_REC_PROD_RATE_OVERRUN_1
telemetry.description: Number of times FSW failed to loop through all EHA, selecting, and packetizing it, before the next packetization production period was suppose to begin. It resets when the TSR is modified or a new TSR set is applied. Every time this increments a production period has been skipped. For the identifed rate priority 1

telemetry.name: DDM_UNFILTERED_PENDING_ALLOCATED_STRIPE_COUNT

telemetry.name: DDM_CFDP_PB_NUM_PKTS_DROP
telemetry.description: The total number of dropped packets in the downlink framing priority buffers since initialization for CFDP protocol packets.

telemetry.name: DDM_CFDP_PB_CUR_PKT_NUM
telemetry.description: This is the current number of packets in the downlink framing priority buffer. This number will increase and decrease as the packets are queued into the buffer and dequeued out of the buffer and put into transfer frame buffers. For CFDP Protocol Packets.

telemetry.name: DDM_CFDP_PB_OW_PKTS
telemetry.description: Total number of packets overwritten in the CFDP Protocol downlink framing priority buffer. This would occur when the packet production rate exceeds the rate that the data is being downlinked. Value resets to 0 whenever downlink starts framing.

telemetry.name: DDM_DP_NUM_DOWNLINK_SENDS_FAILED
telemetry.description: The number of times that dpt_svc attempted to send a packetized DP part to downlink but was unable to do so. This value does not persist across resets.

telemetry.name: DDM_DP_OVERALL_TOTAL_KBYTES
telemetry.description: The total volume in kibibytes (bytes/1024) of all data products which are currently tracked by the data catalog. After a reset, this value is repopulated from nonvolatile data product files. Rounded to the nearest kibibyte.

telemetry.name: DDM_DP_NUM_ACT_UPDATE
telemetry.description: The total number of successful active configuration table update operations.

telemetry.name: DDM_DP_NUM_CFDP_MPDU_NOTIFS_FAILED
telemetry.description: This channel counts the number of times the dpt_svc has attempted to notify cfdp_svc that an MPDU has been packetized and sent to downlink, but failed due to an IPC error. Nominally, this channel should always report 0, but will report the number of failures in an anomaly situation.

telemetry.name: DDM_DP_NUM_CFDP_EPDU_NOTIFS_FAILED
telemetry.description: This channel counts the number of times the dpt_svc has attempted to notify cfdp_svc that an EPDU has been packetized and sent to downlink, but failed due to an IPC error. Nominally, this channel should always report 0, but will report the number of failures in an anomaly situation.

telemetry.name: DDM_DP_NUM_CFDP_CORRUPT_NOTIFS_FAILED
telemetry.description: This channel counts the number of times the dpt_svc has attempted to notify cfdp_svc that a data product has been marked CORRUPT, but failed due to an IPC error. Nominally, this channel should always report 0, but will report the number of failures in an anomaly situation.

telemetry.name: DDM_CFDP_NUM_OPEN_TXNS

telemetry.name: DDM_CFDP_NUM_TOTAL_SUCCESSFUL_TXNS

telemetry.name: DDM_CFDP_NUM_TOTAL_FAILED_TXNS

telemetry.name: DDM_CFDP_LAST_FAILED_FILENAME

telemetry.name: DDM_CFDP_LAST_FAILED_TIMESTAMP

telemetry.name: EIS_WAC_OP_STATUS

telemetry.name: EIS_WAC_CMD_HIST_1

This includes: Least significant five bits of sequence count of the second to last received command (5-bit) Command status code of the second to last received command (3-bit) Opcode of the second to last command (16-bit integer)

telemetry.name: EIS_WAC_CMD_HIST_2

This includes: Least significant five bits of sequence count of the third to last received command (5-bit) Command status code of the third to last received command (3-bit) Opcode of the third to last command (16-bit integer)

telemetry.name: EIS_WAC_CMD_HIST_3
telemetry.description: Consists of the history of the fourth to last Command in the EIS-WAC H&S packet. This includes: Least significant five bits of sequence count of the fourth to last received command (5-bit) Command status code of the fourth to last received command (3-bit) Opcode of the fourth to last command (16-bit integer)

telemetry.name: EIS_WAC_CMD_HIST_4
telemetry.description: Consists of the history of the fifth to last Command in the EIS-WAC H&S packet. This includes: Least significant five bits of sequence count of the fifth to last received command (5-bit) Command status code of the fifth to last received command (3-bit) Opcode of the fifth to last command (16-bit integer)

telemetry.description: Consists of the history of the fourth to last Command in the EIS-NAC H&S packet. telemetry.description: Consists of the history of the fifth to last Command in the EIS-NAC H&S packet. telemetry.name: ETHM_OP_STATUS
telemetry.description: Consists of the Operational Status bits in the E-THEMIS H&S packet. Includes the number of subseconds that have elapsed since the last time sync signal was received, Interface Type, Selected Interface, Busy bit, Panic bit, and Instrument Mode.

telemetry.name: ETHM_CMD_STATUS
telemetry.description: Consists of the Command Status bits in the E-THEMIS H&S packet. Includes command accepted overflow, command accepted counter, command executed overflow, command executed counter, command rejected overflow, and command rejected counter.

telemetry.name: ETHM_CMD_HIST_0
telemetry.description: Consists of the history of the last Command in the E-THEMIS H&S packet. This includes: Least significant five bits of sequence count of the last received command (5-bit) Command status code of last received command (3-bit) Opcode of last command (16-bit integer)

telemetry.name: ETHM_CMD_HIST_1
telemetry.description: Consists of the history of the second to last Command in the E-THEMIS H&S packet. This includes: Least significant five bits of sequence count of the second to last received command (5-bit) Command status code of the second to last received command (3-bit) Opcode of the second to last command (16-bit integer)

telemetry.name: ETHM_CMD_HIST_2
telemetry.description: Consists of the history of the third to last Command in the E-THEMIS H&S packet. This includes: Least significant five bits of sequence count of the third to last received command (5-bit) Command status code of the third to last received command (3-bit) Opcode of the third to last command (16-bit integer)

telemetry.name: ETHM_CMD_HIST_3
telemetry.description: Consists of the history of the fourth to last Command in the E-THEMIS H&S packet. This includes: Least significant five bits of sequence count of the fourth to last received command (5-bit) Command status code of the fourth to last received command (3-bit) Opcode of the fourth to last command (16-bit integer)

telemetry.name: ETHM_CMD_HIST_4
telemetry.description: Consists of the history of the fifth to last Command in the E-THEMIS H&S packet. This includes: Least significant five bits of sequence count of the fifth to last received command (5-bit) Command status code of the fifth to last received command (3-bit) Opcode of the fifth to last command (16-bit integer)

telemetry.name: ETHM_SPW_STATUS
telemetry.description: Consists of the E-THEMIS SpaceWire Error Count in the E-THEMIS H&S packet.

telemetry.name: FSW_BDS_LOG_LAST_UAS_STRIPE_ID_SELECTED_FOR_RECORDING
telemetry.description: Shows the 'logical stripe id' of the last location selected for use by the unfiltered recording logic, plotted over time this can show the wear-leveling as well selection/sorting logic behaviors.

telemetry.name: FSW_BDS_LOG_LAST_UID_STRIPE_ID_UTILIZED_BY_RECORDING
telemetry.description: Shows the 'logical stripe id' of the last location the HW reported to have used for unfiltered instrument data, these rolling values can be used to plot the aggregate speed and frame-to-frame behaviors of the system.

telemetry.name: FSW_BDS_LOG_UNFILTERED_TOTAL_BLE_PRODUCED_BY_FSW_COUNT
telemetry.description: The combination of Block List Entries produced and 'fed' into the hardware pipeline, combined with the total Block List Entries 'utilized' by the hardware and the subsequent Metadata Log Entries retrieved can all be used to plot these behaviors over time. NOTE: "Gaps" are less important when plotting long duration events like a fly-by or full petal simulation. The aggregate data rates will ebb and flow regardless but the overall trajectory of the system as a whole and it's usage of the NAND is required for management of this resource.

telemetry.name: FSW_BDS_LOG_RADMON_LIID_STATUS
telemetry.description: For each instrument tracked by the logical layer (Radmon included) a 'set' of statistics are tracked. These include: 1) Aggregate DWORD Count of the Stream of CCSDS Packets into this interface 2) Aggregate Packet Count of the Stream of CCSDS Packets into this interface 3) Current Filtered Instrument Data Stripe (FID) Count (used for quota and ops awareness) 4) Aggregate DWORD Count of all filtered data for this interface 5) Last Ground Commanded "Set Allocation" for this interface 6) Last Ground Commanded "Set Allocation" time stamp for this interface (let 'set' time) 7) Last Hardware Reported "Remaining Allocation" for this interface 8) Per Interface level Status of Tri-State, NAND-Inhibit, <more to follow>

telemetry.name: FSW_BDS_LOG_UVS_LIID_STATUS
telemetry.description: For each instrument tracked by the logical layer (Radmon included) a 'set' of statistics are tracked. These include: 1) Aggregate DWORD Count of the Stream of CCSDS Packets into this interface 2) Aggregate Packet Count of the Stream of CCSDS Packets into this interface 3) Current Filtered Instrument Data Stripe (FID) Count (used for quota and ops awareness) 4) Aggregate DWORD Count of all filtered data for this interface 5) Last Ground Commanded "Set Allocation" for this interface 6) Last Ground Commanded "Set Allocation" time stamp for this interface (let 'set' time) 7) Last Hardware Reported "Remaining Allocation" for this interface 8) Per Interface level Status of Tri-State, NAND-Inhibit, <more to follow>

telemetry.name: GNC_SRU_A_MRAM_BOOT
telemetry.description: This channel is the the boot bit for the SRU A Health Status word. It specifies the last used boot MRAM (0 = primary, 1 = secondary). (SA 1, Word 2)

telemetry.name: GNC_SRU_A_PU_PWR_5V_ALARM
telemetry.description: This channel is the alarm bit for the SRU A PU 5V power supply, which indicates if there is an alarm on this power supply. (SA 1, Word 2)

telemetry.name: GNC_SRU_A_PU_PWR_3P3V_ALARM
telemetry.description: This channel is the alarm bit for the SRU A PU 3.3V power supply, which indicates if there is an alarm on this power supply. (SA 1, Word 2)

telemetry.name: GNC_SRU_A_PU_PWR_REF_2P5V_ALARM
telemetry.description: This channel is the alarm bit for the SRU A PU 2.5V reference power supply, which indicates if there is an alarm on this power supply (SA 1, Word 2)

telemetry.name: GNC_SRU_A_PU_PWR_1P8V_ALARM
telemetry.description: This channel is the alarm bit for the SRU A PU 1.8V power supply, which indicates if there is an alarm on this power supply (SA 1, Word 2)

telemetry.name: GNC_SRU_A_PU_PWR_2P5V_ALARM
telemetry.description: This channel is the alarm bit for the SRU A PU 2.5V power supply, which indicates if there is an alarm on this power supply (SA 1, Word 2)

telemetry.name: GNC_SRU_A_PU_TEMP_ALARM
telemetry.description: This channel is the SRU A PU temperature alarm bit, which indicates whether PU temperature has exceeded the alarm threshold (SA 1, Word 2)

telemetry.name: GNC_SRU_A_PU_PWR_12V_ALARM
telemetry.description: This channel is the alarm bit for the SRU A PU 12V power supply, which indicates if there is an alarm on this power supply (SA 1, Word 2)

telemetry.name: GNC_SRU_A_MAJOR_ERRORS
telemetry.description: This channel indicates whether any major errors have been detected on SRU A (e.g. watchdog, memory exceptions). This bit is raised when a new error occurs to indicate that Diagnostic has been updated. A Diagnostic TM reading resets these two bits. (SA 1, Word 2)

telemetry.name: GNC_SRU_A_MINOR_ERRORS
telemetry.description: This channel indicates whether any minor errors have been detected on SRU A. This bit is raised when a new error occurs to indicate that Diagnostic has been updated. A Diagnostic TM reading resets these two bits. (SA 1, Word 2)

telemetry.name: GNC_SRU_A_DEGRADED_MODE
telemetry.description: This channel indicates whether SRU A is in degraded mode. This bit is raised when more than 5 consecutive unexpected reboots are detected. (SA 1, Word 2)

telemetry.name: GNC_SRU_A_REBOOT_COUNTER
telemetry.description: This channel is the SRU A reboot counter bit, which counts the total number of SRU A reboots (excluding watchdog). (SA 1, Word 2)

telemetry.name: GNC_SRU_A_NEW_CMD_RECEIVED
telemetry.description: This channel is the new command received bit. The bit flips when a command is received (Toggle to 0 or 1, previous bit value changes when new TC is received, initially set to 0 at EU reset). (SA 1, Word 3)

telemetry.name: GNC_SRU_A_LAST_CMD_VALIDITY
telemetry.description: This channel is the validity bit of the last command received by SRU A. This bit is set to a logic value of one when the command is invalid (contains an error). (SA 1, Word 3)

telemetry.name: GNC_SRU_A_MRAM_WRITE_ALLOWED
telemetry.description: This channel is the no sleep MRAM bit for SRU A. The status of this bit indicates whether a write operation is allowed on the MRAM (0 = Asleep, 1 = No Sleep)

telemetry.name: GNC_SRU_A_MRAM_SCANNING
telemetry.description: This channel is the MRAM scanning bit for SRU A. This bit is set to a logic value of 1 when scanning of MRAM in software background task is activated, and 0 when it is deactivated. By default, the scanning of MRAM is deactivated in software background task after power ON and warm reset. The access of MRAM is controlled by the Asleep/No Sleep command. (SA 1, Word 3)

telemetry.name: GNC_SRU_A_ETR
telemetry.description: This channel indicates whether the ETR has been received by SRU A in the previous cycle. This bit is set to a logic value of 1 if last expected ETR has been received, and 0 if it is missing or simulated. (SA 1, Word 3)

telemetry.name: GNC_SRU_A_FRAME_COUNTER_CHECK
telemetry.description: This channel indicates whether frame counter check is activated or deactivated on SRU A. (SA 1, Word 3)

telemetry.name: GNC_SRU_A_SYNC_PERFORMED
telemetry.description: This channel indicates whether synchronization has been performed or not. Sync bit set to 1 indicates that at least ETRNbSync (parameter) consecutive ETR signals have been received and were in accordance with the expected ETR frequency taking into account the tolerance on ETR reception for parameters definition/setting). An ETR reception outside the expected ETR tolerance window resets this bit to 0 and raises a minor error if it occurs after the expected time window. (SA 1, Word 3)

telemetry.name: GNC_SRU_B_MAJOR_ERRORS
telemetry.description: This channel indicates whether any major errors have been detected on SRU B (e.g. watchdog, memory exceptions). This bit is raised when a new error occurs to indicate that Diagnostic has been updated. A Diagnostic TM reading resets these two bits. (SA 1, Word 2)

telemetry.name: GNC_SRU_B_MINOR_ERRORS
telemetry.description: This channel indicates whether any minor errors have been detected on SRU B. This bit is raised when a new error occurs to indicate that Diagnostic has been updated. A Diagnostic TM reading resets these two bits. (SA 1, Word 2)

telemetry.name: GNC_SRU_B_DEGRADED_MODE
telemetry.description: This channel indicates whether SRU B is in degraded mode. This bit is raised when more than 5 consecutive unexpected reboots are detected. (SA 1, Word 2)

telemetry.name: GNC_SRU_B_REBOOT_COUNTER
telemetry.description: This channel is the SRU B reboot counter bit, which counts the total number of SRU B reboots (excluding watchdog). (SA 1, Word 2)

telemetry.name: GNC_SRU_B_NEW_CMD_RECEIVED
telemetry.description: This channel is the new command received bit. The bit flips when a command is received (Toggle to 0 or 1, previous bit value changes when new TC is received, initially set to 0 at EU reset). (SA 1, Word 3)

telemetry.name: GNC_SRU_B_LAST_CMD_VALIDITY
telemetry.description: This channel is the validity bit of the last command received by SRU B. This bit is set to a logic value of one when the command is invalid (contains an error). (SA 1, Word 3)

telemetry.name: GNC_SRU_B_MRAM_WRITE_ALLOWED
telemetry.description: This channel is the no sleep MRAM bit for SRU B. The status of this bit indicates whether a write operation is allowed on the MRAM (0 = Asleep, 1 = No Sleep)

telemetry.name: GNC_SRU_B_MRAM_SCANNING
telemetry.description: This channel is the MRAM scanning bit for SRU B. This bit is set to a logic value of 1 when scanning of MRAM in software background task is activated, and 0 when it is deactivated. By default, the scanning of MRAM is deactivated in software background task after power ON and warm reset. The access of MRAM is controlled by the Asleep/No Sleep command. (SA 1, Word 3)

telemetry.name: GNC_SRU_B_ETR
telemetry.description: This channel indicates whether the ETR has been received by SRU B in the previous cycle. This bit is set to a logic value of 1 if last expected ETR has been received, and 0 if it is missing or simulated. (SA 1, Word 3)

telemetry.name: GNC_SRU_B_FRAME_COUNTER_CHECK

telemetry.name: GNC_SRU_A_AAM_ACQUISITION_ALGORITHM
telemetry.description: This channel indicates whether SRU A is using the Europa or Hydra algorithm in attitude acquisition mode. (SA 13, Word 3)

telemetry.name: GNC_SRU_A_AAM_FDIR_ENABLED
telemetry.description: This channel indicates whether the FDIR function is enabled on SRU A in attitude acquisition mode. (SA 13, Word 3)

telemetry.name: GNC_SRU_A_AAM_ANGULAR_RATE_SUPPLIED
telemetry.description: This channel indicates whether an angular rate for SRU A is supplied by the telecommand. (SA 13, Word 3)

telemetry.name: GNC_SRU_A_AAM_TRIGGERED_ACQUISITION
telemetry.description: This channel indicates whether acquisition is performed autonomously or triggered on SRU A. This bit is set to a logic value of 0 when pattern recognition is performed autonomously as soon as AAM gets a valid synchronized image. This bit is set to a logic value of 1 if the AAM mode is recurrent and pattern recognition is performed only after the reception of a Trigger Acquisition telecommand. (SA 13, Word 3)

telemetry.name: GNC_SRU_A_AAM_DESIGNATED_QUATERNION
telemetry.description: This channel indicates whether acquisition uses a dedicated quaterion or is autonomous on SRU A. This bit is set to a logic value of 0 when the star tracker performs an autonomous "lost in space" attitude initialization. This bit is set to a logic value of 1 when the star tracker acquisition mode uses the provided designation quaternion. This bit has priority over GNC_SRU_AAM_TRIGGERED_ACQUISITION. (SA 13, Word 3)

telemetry.name: GNC_SRU_A_AAM_ATT_PROCESSING_NUMERIC_ERROR
telemetry.description: This channel indicates whether there is a numeric problem with attitude processing during the SRU A coherence test. (SA 13, Word 4)

telemetry.name: GNC_SRU_A_AAM_INCOHERENT_STAR_QI
telemetry.description: This channel indicates whether the quality index of stars is incoherent during the SRU A coherence test. (SA 13, Word 4)

telemetry.name: GNC_SRU_A_AAM_INCOHERENT_ATT_QI
telemetry.description: This channel indicates whether the attitude quality index is incoherent during the SRU A coherence test. (SA 13, Word 4)

telemetry.name: GNC_SRU_A_AAM_INSUFFICIENT_MEASURED_STARS
telemetry.description: This channel indicates whether the number of measured stars too small during the SRU A coherence test. (SA 13, Word 4)

telemetry.name: GNC_SRU_A_AAM_MAX_UPLETS_TOO_LARGE
telemetry.description: This channel indicates whether the max number of uplets (tuples) is too large during the SRU A coherence test. (SA 13, Word 4)

telemetry.name: GNC_SRU_A_AAM_MAX_CONSTELLATIONS_TOO_LARGE
telemetry.description: This channel indicates whether the max number of constellations is too large during the SRU A coherence test. (SA 13, Word 4)

telemetry.name: GNC_SRU_A_AAM_FALSE_STAR_PATTERN_RECOGNITION
telemetry.description: This bit is set to a logic value of 1 if false star pattern recognition occurs during the SRU A coherence test. (SA 13, Word 4)

telemetry.name: GNC_SRU_A_AAM_NO_STAR_PATTERN_RECOGNITION
telemetry.description: This bit is set to a logic value of 1 if no star pattern recognition occurs during the SRU A coherence test. (SA 13, Word 4)

telemetry.name: GNC_SRU_A_AAM_TC_DESIGNATION_WINDOW_TOO_LARGE
telemetry.description: This channel indicates whether the TC designation window is larger than the max limit during the SRU A coherence test. (SA 13, Word 4)

telemetry.name: GNC_SRU_A_AAM_DES_QUAT_NORM_ERROR
telemetry.description: This bit is set to a logic value of 1 if the designation quaternion is not normalized to 1 or null or has been normalized or set to idenity during the SRU A coherence test. (SA 13, Word 4)

telemetry.name: GNC_SRU_A_ATM_PRECESSION_CORRECTION
telemetry.description: This channel indicates whether precession correction is enabled in attitude tracking mode on SRU A (when applied, attitude quaternions describe attitudes with respect to mean of date reference frames instead of Rc). (SA 13, Word 3)

telemetry.name: GNC_SRU_A_ATM_ABERRATION_CORRECTION
telemetry.description: This channel indicates whether aberration correction is enabled in attitude tracking mode on SRU A. (SA 13, Word 3)

telemetry.name: GNC_SRU_A_ATM_AUTONOMOUS_EARTH_SUN_VEL_VECTOR
telemetry.description: This channel indicates whether autonomous calculation of the Earth/Sun velocity vector for aberration correction is enabled in attitude tracking mode on SRU A. (SA 13, Word 3)

telemetry.name: GNC_SRU_A_ATM_AUTONOMOUS_SATELLITE_EARTH_VEL_VECTOR
telemetry.description: This channel indicates whether autonomous calculation of the Satellite/Earth velocity vector for aberration correction is enabled in attitude tracking mode on SRU A. (SA 13, Word 3)

telemetry.name: GNC_SRU_A_ATM_UPDATE_COMMAND_VEL_VECTOR
telemetry.description: This channel indicates whether the star tracker shall take the 'update command' velocity vector into account when correcting aberrations, instead of calculating linear velocities. This bit will be set to a logic value of 1 if this function is enabled in attitude tracking mode on SRU A. (SA 13, Word 3)

telemetry.name: GNC_SRU_A_ATM_FDIR_ENABLED
telemetry.description: This channel indicates wether the FDIR function is enabled in attitude tracking mode on SRU A. (SA 13, Word 3)

telemetry.name: GNC_SRU_A_ATM_ANGULAR_RATE_SUPPLIED
telemetry.description: This channel indicates whether the angular rate is supplied by telecommand during attitude tracking mode on SRU A. (SA 13, Word 3)

telemetry.name: GNC_SRU_A_ATM_DIFF_EXPECTED_MEAS_ANG_RATE_TOO_LARGE
telemetry.description: This channel indicates whether the difference between expected and measured attitude is too large in attitude tracking mode on SRU A. (SA 13, Word 4)

telemetry.name: GNC_SRU_A_ATM_INSUFFICIENT_COHERENT_STARS
telemetry.description: This channel indicates whether the number of measured and coherent stars is too small to calculate attitude in attitude tracking mode on SRU A (this bit is set to a logic value of 1 when QRs is null). (SA 13, Word 4)

telemetry.name: GNC_SRU_A_ATM_ATT_PROCESSING_NUMERIC_ERROR
telemetry.description: This channel indicates whether there is a numeric problem with attitude processing in attitude tracking mode on SRU A. (SA 13, Word 4)

telemetry.name: GNC_SRU_A_ATM_EXTENDED_OBJECTS_IN_OH1_FOV
telemetry.description: This channel indicates whether the presence of extended objects (moon, etc.) is suspected in the OH1 FOV in attitude tracking mode on SRU A. (SA 13, Word 4)

telemetry.name: GNC_SRU_A_ATM_EXTENDED_OBJECTS_IN_OH2_FOV
telemetry.description: This channel indicates whether the presence of extended objects (moon, etc.) is suspected in the OH2 FOV in attitude tracking mode on SRU A. (SA 13, Word 4)

telemetry.name: GNC_SRU_A_ATM_DES_QUAT_ERROR
telemetry.description: This channel indicates whether the designation quaternion of ATM telecommand is not normalized to 1 (resp. is null), and has been normalized (resp. set to identity) on SRU A.

telemetry.name: GNC_SRU_A_ATM_OH1_FUSED_QUAT
telemetry.description: This channel indicates whether measurements from OH1 are used in fused quaternion in attitude tracking mode on SRU A. (SA 13, Word 5)

telemetry.name: GNC_SRU_A_ATM_OH2_FUSED_QUAT
telemetry.description: This channel indicates whether measurements from OH2 are used in fused quaternion in attitude tracking mode on SRU A. (SA 13, Word 5)

telemetry.name: GNC_SRU_A_ATM_OH1_INTERNAL_REF_HEAD

telemetry.name: GNC_SRU_A_ATM_OH1_EXTERNAL_REF_HEAD

telemetry.name: GNC_SRU_B_ATM_PRECESSION_CORRECTION
telemetry.description: This channel indicates whether precession correction is enabled in attitude tracking mode on SRU B (when applied, attitude quaternions describe attitudes with respect to mean of date reference frames instead of Rc). (SA 13, Word 3)

telemetry.name: GNC_SRU_B_ATM_ABERRATION_CORRECTION
telemetry.description: This channel indicates whether aberration correction is enabled in attitude tracking mode on SRU B. (SA 13, Word 3)

telemetry.name: GNC_SRU_B_ATM_AUTONOMOUS_EARTH_SUN_VEL_VECTOR

telemetry.name: GNC_SRU_B_ATM_AUTONOMOUS_SATELLITE_EARTH_VEL_VECTOR

telemetry.name: GNC_SRU_B_ATM_UPDATE_COMMAND_VEL_VECTOR
telemetry.description: This channel indicates whether the star tracker shall take the 'update command' velocity vector into account when correcting aberrations, instead of calculating linear velocities. This bit will be set to a logic value of 1 if this function is enabled in attitude tracking mode on SRU B. (SA 13, Word 3)

telemetry.name: GNC_SRU_B_ATM_FDIR_ENABLED

telemetry.name: GNC_IMU_A_GYRO_A_HOT_START
telemetry.description: This channel is the SSIRU A Gyro A Hot Start status. This bit shall be set to a value of logic 1 (active state) when the gyro electrical angle has been recovered within 6 seconds of initialization of the software. Status will not be indicated prior to this 6 second time-out. An active state indicates that the corresponding angle value presented in S/A 25 words 2-5 are valid. It will be cleared within 20 milliseconds of a read of S/A 25 by the bus controller. (T-SA 16, word 18)

telemetry.name: GNC_IMU_A_GYRO_A_FAIL
telemetry.description: This channel is the SSIRU A Gyro A failure status.This bit shall be set to a value of logic 1 to indicate that the SSIRU gyro channel A is inoperative. This bit is the logic OR of the bits contained in the associated gyro detailed bit status word. The data validity bit shall remain cleared until all failures, which set the gyro Failure bit to a value of logic 1, are cleared. (T-SA 17, word 1)

telemetry.name: GNC_IMU_A_SEL_PROCESS_FAIL
telemetry.description: This channel is the SSIRU A selected processor failure status. This bit shall be set to a value of logic 1 to indicate that the selected Processor electronics are inoperative. The MIL-STD-1553B interface hardware shall remain operational but message transfers on both bus A and B will result in indeterminate results (e.g. incorrect inertial data transmission and/or update). (T-SA 17, word 1)

telemetry.name: GNC_IMU_A_CHKSUM_PROG
telemetry.description: This channel is the SSIRU A checksum progress status. This bit shall be set to a value of logic 1 immediately following the receipt of the checksum go message. It shall be set to a logical value of 0 on completion of the check summing of downloaded OPF. (T-SA 17, word 1)

telemetry.name: GNC_IMU_A_CHKSUM_ERR
telemetry.description: This channel is the SSIRU A checksum error status.This bit shall be valid after the Checksum In Progress bit transitions from a one to a zero, and shall indicate that an error was detected when check summing the downloaded OFP. (T-SA 17, word 1)

telemetry.name: GNC_IMU_B_CHKSUM_ERR

telemetry.name: GNC_IMU_A_GYRO_A_PARAM_DRIVE_SAT
telemetry.description: This channel is the SSIRU A Gyro A parametric drive saturation bit. This bit shall be set to a value of logic 1 to indicate that the gyro parametric drive capability has been exceeded. Gyro control is maintained (if possible) but the gyro channel performance may be severely impaired. Note: This bit may be set for a few seconds during the transition from FTR to Whole Angle Mode and subsequently cleared without affecting the performance. (T-SA 17, word 2)

telemetry.name: GNC_IMU_B_GYRO_D_ELEC_TEMP_SENS_FAIL
telemetry.description: This channel is the SSIRU B Gyro D Electronics Temperature Sensor Failure.This bit shall be set to a value of logic 1 to indicate that the gyro electronics temperature sensor has failed. Gyro performance will be degraded. (T-SA 17, Word 5)

telemetry.name: GNC_IMU_A_EDC_SELF_TEST_FAIL
telemetry.description: This channel is the SSIRU A EDC Self Test Failure bit. This bit shall be set to a value of logic 1 to indicate the Super Space HRG and Accelerometer Readout Controller (SSHARC) Error Detection Correction (EDC) logic failed self-test. SSIRU gyro and accelerometer data validity bits shall be unaffected by the setting of this bit, however gyro and accelerometer performance may be degraded if this bit is set. (T-SA 17, Word 6)

telemetry.name: GNC_IMU_A_ERR_EXT_MEM
telemetry.description: This channel is the SSIRU A EDC Single or Multi-bit Error in External Memory. This bit shall be set to a value of logic 1 to indicate that a single or multi-bit data memory error has been detected in external (data or program) RAM memory. Upon occurrence of this error, the GSP software may halt operation. This bit shall be cleared once the Processor electronics detailed bit status message is read by the bus controller. (T-SA 17, Word 6)

telemetry.name: GNC_IMU_A_PROCESS_PARITY_CHK_SELF_TEST_FAIL
telemetry.description: This channel is the SSIRU A Processor Internal Program Parity Checker Self-Test Failure bit. This bit shall be set to a value of logic 1 to indicate that the SSHARC Processor internal Program Parity checker failed its self-test. SSIRU gyro and accelerometer data validity bits shall be unaffected by the setting of this bit, however, gyro and accelerometer performance may be degraded if this bit is set. If the SSIRU OFP is stored in internal PROM, the processor shall re-load the faulty location. If the SSIRU OFP is downloaded over the system data bus, then the SSIRU will re-initialize and await download of the OFP. (T-SA 17, Word 6)

telemetry.name: GNC_IMU_A_PROCESS_STUCK_BIT_PROG_MEM
telemetry.description: This channel is the SSIRU A Processor Stuck Bit in Program Memory bit. This bit shall be set to a value of logic 1 to indicate that the SSHARC Processor Program memory has a non-correctable memory error condition. (T-SA 17, Word 6)

telemetry.name: GNC_IMU_A_PROCESS_STACK_UNDERFLOW
telemetry.description: This channel is the SSIRU A Processor Stack Underflow bit. The SSHARC Processor Program stack underflow and overflow are detected by this bit. This bit shall be set to a value of logic 1 to indicate that the SSHARC Processor Program stack underflowed. SSIRU gyro and accelerometer data validity bits shall be cleared by the setting of this bit. Note that an overflow of the processor stack will result in the processor halting and therefore will not generate output on the MIL-STD-1553B interface. This will require the user to power cycle the SSIRU and re-load the OFP (if loaded over the system bus) to resume normal operation. (T-SA 17, Word 6)

telemetry.name: GNC_IMU_A_IOC_PARITY_CHK_SELF_TEST_FAIL
telemetry.description: This channel is the SSIRU A IOC Program Parity Checker Self Test Failure bit. This bit shall be set to a value of logic 1 to indicate that the SSHARC IOC Program Parity checker failed its self-test. SSIRU gyro and accelerometer data validity bits and gyro and accelerometer performance are unaffected if this bit is set. However, the MIL-STD-1553B bus may operate erroneously if this bit is set. (T-SA 17, Word 6)

telemetry.name: GNC_IMU_A_IOC_STUCK_BIT_PROG_MEM
telemetry.description: This channel is the SSIRU A IOC Stuck Bit in Program Memory. This bit shall be set to a value of logic 1 to indicate that the SSHARC IOC Program memory has a non-correctable memory error condition. SSIRU gyro and accelerometer data validity bits and gyro and accelerometer performance are unaffected if this bit is set. However, the MIL-STD-1553B bus may operate erroneously if this bit is set. (T-SA 17, Word 6)

telemetry.name: GNC_IMU_A_RS422_SELF_TEST_FAIL
telemetry.description: This channel is the SSIRU A RS-422 Self Test Failure bit. This bit shall be set to a value of logic 1 to indicate a SSHARC RS-422 Interface failure has occurred during power-on BIT. (T-SA 17, Word 6)

telemetry.name: GNC_IMU_A_GUPI_A_INTERRUPT_FAIL
telemetry.description: This channel is the SSIRU A GUPI A Interrupt Failure bit. This bit shall be set to a value of logic 1 to indicate that the SSHARC GUPI A interrupt request was not generated as expected. The associated gyro validity bit shall be cleared if this bit is set. (T-SA 17, Word 6)

telemetry.name: GNC_IMU_A_GUPI_B_INTERRUPT_FAIL
telemetry.description: This channel is the SSIRU A GUPI B Interrupt Failure bit. This bit shall be set to a value of logic 1 to indicate that the SSHARC GUPI B interrupt request was not generated as expected. The associated gyro validity bit shall be cleared if this bit is set. (T-SA 17, Word 6)

telemetry.name: GNC_IMU_A_GUPI_C_INTERRUPT_FAIL
telemetry.description: This channel is the SSIRU A GUPI C Interrupt Failure bit. This bit shall be set to a value of logic 1 to indicate that the SSHARC GUPI C interrupt request was not generated as expected. The associated gyro validity bit shall be cleared if this bit is set. (T-SA 17, Word 6)

telemetry.name: GNC_IMU_A_GUPI_D_INTERRUPT_FAIL
telemetry.description: This channel is the SSIRU A GUPI D Interrupt Failure bit. This bit shall be set to a value of logic 1 to indicate that the SSHARC GUPI D interrupt request was not generated as expected. The associated gyro validity bit shall be cleared if this bit is set. (T-SA 17, Word 6)

telemetry.name: GNC_IMU_A_DIODE_TEMP_SENS_FAIL
telemetry.description: This channel is the SSIRU A Diode Temperature Sensor Failure bit. This bit shall be set to a value of logic 1 to indicate that the diode temperature sensor has failed. Gyro performance will be degraded. (T-SA 17, Word 6)

telemetry.name: GNC_IMU_A_PROM_INTEGRITY_FAIL
telemetry.description: This channel is the SSIRU A PROM Integrity Failure bit. This bit shall be set to a value of logic 1 to indicate that the CPU Electronics PROM failed the background memory integrity test. Operation of the system is not impaired since the PROM is only used at power on reset. SSIRU gyro and accelerometer data validity bits are unaffected by the setting of this bit and gyro and accelerometer performance are unaffected if this bit is set. (T-SA 17, Word 6)

telemetry.name: GNC_IMU_A_PROCESS_STUCK_BIT_DATA_MEM
telemetry.description: This channel is the SSIRU A Processor Stuck Bit in Data Memory. This bit shall be set to a value of logic 1 to indicate that the SSHARC Processor data memory has a non-correctable memory error condition. (T-SA 17, Word 6)

telemetry.name: GNC_IMU_A_LOOP_TIMER_PWR_ON_SELF_TEST_FAIL
telemetry.description: This channel is the SSIRU A Loop Timer Power-on Self Test Failure bit. This bit shall be set to a value of logic 1 to indicate that the CPU Electronics loop timer is non-operational. All SSIRU gyro and accelerometer data validity bits shall be cleared by the setting of this bit and gyro and accelerometer data words shall not be updated. (T-SA 17, Word 6)

telemetry.name: GNC_IMU_B_EDC_SELF_TEST_FAIL
telemetry.description: This channel is the SSIRU B EDC Self Test Failure bit. This bit shall be set to a value of logic 1 to indicate the Super Space HRG and Accelerometer Readout Controller (SSHARC) Error Detection Correction (EDC) logic failed self-test. SSIRU gyro and accelerometer data validity bits shall be unaffected by the setting of this bit, however gyro and accelerometer performance may be degraded if this bit is set. (T-SA 17, Word 6)

telemetry.name: GNC_IMU_B_ERR_EXT_MEM
telemetry.description: This channel is the SSIRU B EDC Single or Multi-bit Error in External Memory. This bit shall be set to a value of logic 1 to indicate that a single or multi-bit data memory error has been detected in external (data or program) RAM memory. Upon occurrence of this error, the GSP software may halt operation. This bit shall be cleared once the Processor electronics detailed bit status message is read by the bus controller. (T-SA 17, Word 6)

telemetry.name: GNC_IMU_B_PROCESS_PARITY_CHK_SELF_TEST_FAIL
telemetry.description: This channel is the SSIRU B Processor Internal Program Parity Checker Self-Test Failure bit. This bit shall be set to a value of logic 1 to indicate that the SSHARC Processor internal Program Parity checker failed its self-test. SSIRU gyro and accelerometer data validity bits shall be unaffected by the setting of this bit, however, gyro and accelerometer performance may be degraded if this bit is set. If the SSIRU OFP is stored in internal PROM, the processor shall re-load the faulty location. If the SSIRU OFP is downloaded over the system data bus, then the SSIRU will re-initialize and await download of the OFP. (T-SA 17, Word 6)

telemetry.name: GNC_IMU_B_PROCESS_STUCK_BIT_PROG_MEM
telemetry.description: This channel is the SSIRU B Processor Stuck Bit in Program Memory bit. This bit shall be set to a value of logic 1 to indicate that the SSHARC Processor Program memory has a non-correctable memory error condition. (T-SA 17, Word 6)

telemetry.name: GNC_IMU_B_PROCESS_STACK_UNDERFLOW
telemetry.description: This channel is the SSIRU B Processor Stack Underflow bit. The SSHARC Processor Program stack underflow and overflow are detected by this bit. This bit shall be set to a value of logic 1 to indicate that the SSHARC Processor Program stack underflowed. SSIRU gyro and accelerometer data validity bits shall be cleared by the setting of this bit. Note that an overflow of the processor stack will result in the processor halting and therefore will not generate output on the MIL-STD-1553B interface. This will require the user to power cycle the SSIRU Bnd re-load the OFP (if loaded over the system bus) to resume normal operation. (T-SA 17, Word 6)

telemetry.name: GNC_IMU_B_IOC_PARITY_CHK_SELF_TEST_FAIL
telemetry.description: This channel is the SSIRU B IOC Program Parity Checker Self Test Failure bit. This bit shall be set to a value of logic 1 to indicate that the SSHARC IOC Program Parity checker failed its self-test. SSIRU gyro and accelerometer data validity bits and gyro and accelerometer performance are unaffected if this bit is set. However, the MIL-STD-1553B bus may operate erroneously if this bit is set. (T-SA 17, Word 6)

telemetry.name: GNC_IMU_B_IOC_STUCK_BIT_PROG_MEM
telemetry.description: This channel is the SSIRU B IOC Stuck Bit in Program Memory. This bit shall be set to a value of logic 1 to indicate that the SSHARC IOC Program memory has a non-correctable memory error condition. SSIRU gyro and accelerometer data validity bits and gyro and accelerometer performance are unaffected if this bit is set. However, the MIL-STD-1553B bus may operate erroneously if this bit is set. (T-SA 17, Word 6)

telemetry.name: GNC_IMU_B_RS422_SELF_TEST_FAIL
telemetry.description: This channel is the SSIRU B RS-422 Self Test Failure bit. This bit shall be set to a value of logic 1 to indicate a SSHARC RS-422 Interface failure has occurred during power-on BIT. (T-SA 17, Word 6)

telemetry.name: GNC_IMU_B_GUPI_A_INTERRUPT_FAIL
telemetry.description: This channel is the SSIRU B GUPI A Interrupt Failure bit. This bit shall be set to a value of logic 1 to indicate that the SSHARC GUPI A interrupt request was not generated as expected. The associated gyro validity bit shall be cleared if this bit is set. (T-SA 17, Word 6)

telemetry.name: GNC_IMU_B_GUPI_B_INTERRUPT_FAIL
telemetry.description: This channel is the SSIRU B GUPI B Interrupt Failure bit. This bit shall be set to a value of logic 1 to indicate that the SSHARC GUPI B interrupt request was not generated as expected. The associated gyro validity bit shall be cleared if this bit is set. (T-SA 17, Word 6)

telemetry.name: GNC_IMU_B_GUPI_C_INTERRUPT_FAIL
telemetry.description: This channel is the SSIRU B GUPI C Interrupt Failure bit. This bit shall be set to a value of logic 1 to indicate that the SSHARC GUPI C interrupt request was not generated as expected. The associated gyro validity bit shall be cleared if this bit is set. (T-SA 17, Word 6)

telemetry.name: GNC_IMU_B_GUPI_D_INTERRUPT_FAIL
telemetry.description: This channel is the SSIRU B GUPI D Interrupt Failure bit. This bit shall be set to a value of logic 1 to indicate that the SSHARC GUPI D interrupt request was not generated as expected. The associated gyro validity bit shall be cleared if this bit is set. (T-SA 17, Word 6)

telemetry.name: GNC_IMU_B_DIODE_TEMP_SENS_FAIL
telemetry.description: This channel is the SSIRU B Diode Temperature Sensor Failure bit. This bit shall be set to a value of logic 1 to indicate that the diode temperature sensor has failed. Gyro performance will be degraded. (T-SA 17, Word 6)

telemetry.name: GNC_IMU_B_PROM_INTEGRITY_FAIL
telemetry.description: This channel is the SSIRU B PROM Integrity Failure bit. This bit shall be set to a value of logic 1 to indicate that the CPU Electronics PROM failed the background memory integrity test. Operation of the system is not impaired since the PROM is only used at power on reset. SSIRU gyro and accelerometer data validity bits are unaffected by the setting of this bit and gyro and accelerometer performance are unaffected if this bit is set. (T-SA 17, Word 6)

telemetry.name: GNC_IMU_B_PROCESS_STUCK_BIT_DATA_MEM
telemetry.description: This channel is the SSIRU B Processor Stuck Bit in Data Memory. This bit shall be set to a value of logic 1 to indicate that the SSHARC Processor data memory has a non-correctable memory error condition. (T-SA 17, Word 6)

telemetry.name: GNC_IMU_B_LOOP_TIMER_PWR_ON_SELF_TEST_FAIL
telemetry.description: This channel is the SSIRU B Loop Timer Power-on Self Test Failure bit. This bit shall be set to a value of logic 1 to indicate that the CPU Electronics loop timer is non-operational. All SSIRU gyro and accelerometer data validity bits shall be cleared by the setting of this bit and gyro and accelerometer data words shall not be updated. (T-SA 17, Word 6)

telemetry.name: GNC_IMU_A_GYRO_A_V100N_OUT_OF_TOL
telemetry.description: This channel is the SSIRU A Gyro A V100N Out of Tolerance bit. This bit shall be set to a value of logic 1 to indicate that the power supply -100Vdc secondary supply voltage as measured at Gyro A is out of tolerance by +/-10% or more. Gyro A performance may be severely degraded if this bit is set. (T-SA 17, Word 7)

telemetry.description: This channel is the SSIRU A Gyro A Phase Lock Loop Enabled bit. This bit when set to a value of logic 1 shall indicate that the phase lock loop is enabled. (T-SA 21, Word 14)

telemetry.name: GNC_IMU_A_GYRO_A_AMP_CL_ENABLED
telemetry.description: This channel is the SSIRU A Gyro A Amplitude Control Loop Enabled bit. This bit when set to a value of logic 1 shall indicate that the amplitude control loop is enabled. (T-SA 21, Word 14)

telemetry.name: GNC_IMU_A_GYRO_A_QUAD_CL_ENABLED
telemetry.description: This channel is the SSIRU A Gyro A Quadrature Control Loop enabled bit. This bit when set to a value of logic 1 shall indicate that the quadrature control loop is enabled. (T-SA 21, Word 14)

telemetry.name: GNC_IMU_A_GYRO_A_RATE_CL_ENABLED
telemetry.description: This channel is the SSIRU A Gyro A Rate Control Loop Enabled bit. This bit when set to a value of logic 1 shall indicate that the rate control loop is enabled. (T-SA 21, Word 14)

telemetry.name: GNC_IMU_A_GYRO_A_CL_SF_HIGH_RES_MODE
telemetry.description: This channel is the SSIRU A Gyro A Closed Loop SF in High-Resolution Mode bit. (T-SA 21, Word 14)

telemetry.name: GNC_IMU_A_GYRO_A_DIODE_HTR_SAT
telemetry.description: This channel is the SSIRU A Gyro A Diode Heater Saturated bit. This bit when set shall to a value of logic 1 indicate that the diode heater has saturated. (T-SA 21, Word 14)

telemetry.name: GNC_IMU_A_GYRO_A_DIODE_HTR_ON
telemetry.description: This channel is the SSIRU A Gyro A Diode Heater on bit. This bit when set shall to a value of logic 1 indicate that the diode heater is enabled. (T-SA 21, Word 14)

telemetry.name: GNC_IMU_A_GYRO_A_HTR_ON
telemetry.description: This channel is the SSIRU A Gyro A Heater on bit. This bit when set shall to a value of logic 1 indicate that the gyro heater is enabled. (T-SA 21, Word 14)

telemetry.name: GNC_IMU_A_GYRO_A_HTR_SAT
telemetry.description: This channel is the SSIRU A Gyro A Heater Saturated bit. This bit shall be set to a value of logic 1 to indicate that the gyro heater is saturated to full scale indicating that maximum heater power is requested and that Gyro performance may be degraded. This bit should not remain set after the gyro warm-up period, providing the unit baseplate temperature is within the performance operating temperature range. (T-SA 21, Word 14)

telemetry.name: GNC_IMU_A_GYRO_A_RATE_DRIVE_OVER_FTR_LMT
telemetry.description: This channel is the SSIRU A Gyro A Rate Drive Above FTR Saturation Limit bit. This bit shall be set to a value of logic 1 to indicate that the rate measurement is above the force to rebalance saturation limit or that the rate DAC drive is saturated. (T-SA 21, Word 14)

telemetry.name: GNC_IMU_A_GYRO_A_START_SEQ_TIMEOUT
telemetry.description: This channel is the SSIRU A Gyro A Start Sequence Time-out bit. This bit shall be set to a value of logic 1 to indicate that the gyro start-up sequence did not complete within the allocated length of time. telemetry.description: This channel is the SSIRU B Gyro C Amplitude Control Loop Enabled bit. This bit when set to a value of logic 1 shall indicate that the amplitude control loop is enabled. (T-SA 23, Word 14)

telemetry.name: GNC_IMU_B_GYRO_C_QUAD_CL_ENABLED
telemetry.description: This channel is the SSIRU B Gyro C Quadrature Control Loop enabled bit. This bit when set to a value of logic 1 shall indicate that the quadrature control loop is enabled. (T-SA 23, Word 14)

telemetry.name: GNC_IMU_B_GYRO_C_RATE_CL_ENABLED
telemetry.description: This channel is the SSIRU B Gyro C Rate Control Loop Enabled bit. This bit when set to a value of logic 1 shall indicate that the rate control loop is enabled. (T-SA 23, Word 14)

telemetry.name: GNC_IMU_B_GYRO_C_CL_SF_HIGH_RES_MODE
telemetry.description: This channel is the SSIRU B Gyro C Closed Loop SF in High-Resolution Mode bit. (T-SA 23, Word 14)

telemetry.name: GNC_IMU_B_GYRO_C_DIODE_HTR_SAT
telemetry.description: This channel is the SSIRU B Gyro C Diode Heater Saturated bit. This bit when set shall to a value of logic 1 indicate that the diode heater has saturated. (T-SA 23, Word 14)

telemetry.name: GNC_IMU_B_GYRO_C_DIODE_HTR_ON
telemetry.description: This channel is the SSIRU B Gyro C Diode Heater on bit. This bit when set shall to a value of logic 1 indicate that the diode heater is enabled. (T-SA 23, Word 14)

telemetry.name: GNC_IMU_B_GYRO_C_HTR_ON
telemetry.description: This channel is the SSIRU B Gyro C Heater on bit. This bit when set shall to a value of logic 1 indicate that the gyro heater is enabled. (T-SA 23, Word 14)

telemetry.name: GNC_IMU_B_GYRO_C_HTR_SAT
telemetry.description: This channel is the SSIRU B Gyro C Heater Saturated bit. This bit shall be set to a value of logic 1 to indicate that the gyro heater is saturated to full scale indicating that maximum heater power is requested and that Gyro performance may be degraded. This bit should not remain set after the gyro warm-up period, providing the unit baseplate temperature is within the performance operating temperature range. (T-SA 23, Word 14)

telemetry.name: GNC_IMU_B_GYRO_C_RATE_DRIVE_OVER_FTR_LMT
telemetry.description: This channel is the SSIRU B Gyro C Rate Drive Above FTR Saturation Limit bit. This bit shall be set to a value of logic 1 to indicate that the rate measurement is above the force to rebalance saturation limit or that the rate DAC drive is saturated. (T-SA 23, Word 14)

telemetry.name: GNC_IMU_B_GYRO_C_START_SEQ_TIMEOUT
telemetry.description: This channel is the SSIRU B Gyro C Start Sequence Time-out bit. This bit shall be set to a value of logic 1 to indicate that the gyro start-up sequence did not complete within the allocated length of time. The SSIRU Processor software continues to attempts gyro start-up until successful. However, this error condition will not clear until a processor/power reset. (T-SA 23, Word 14)

telemetry.name: GNC_IMU_B_GYRO_C_EDITING_NDCOS
telemetry.description: This channel is the SSIRU B Gyro C Editing NdCos bit. This bit shall be set to a value of logic 1 to indicate that the nodal cosine is being extrapolated because of an SEU event. (T-SA 23, Word 14)

telemetry.name: GNC_IMU_B_GYRO_C_AMP_OVER_PARAM_DR_THRESH
telemetry.description: This channel is the SSIRU B Gyro C Amplitude Above Parametric Drive Threshold. This bit shall be set to a value of logic 1 to indicate that the antinodal flexing amplitude has achieved sufficient amplitude to turn on the parametric drive. (T-SA 23, Word 14)

telemetry.name: GNC_IMU_B_GYRO_C_AMP_OVER_PLL_THRESH

telemetry.name: GNC_IMU_B_GYRO_C_QUAD_DRIVE_SAT
telemetry.description: This channel is the SSIRU B Gyro C Quadrature Drive Saturated bit. This bit shall be set to a value of logic 1 to indicate that the quadrature drive has saturated to full-scale. (T-SA 23, Word 14)

telemetry.name: GNC_IMU_B_GYRO_C_QUAD_LOOP_ERR_BELO_CLOS_THRESH

telemetry.name: GNC_IMU_A_RS422_GYRO_A_ANGLE_VALID
telemetry.description: This channel is the SSIRU A Gyro A RS422 bit for Angle validity. This bit shall indicate the validity of the data word contained in this message as follows: When set to a value of logic 0, the Gyro A Integrated Angular Rate data word is invalid. When set to a value of logic 1, the Gyro A Integrated Angular Rate data word is valid. See IMU Vendor EICD for further description. (F7 word 8)

telemetry.name: GNC_IMU_A_RS422_GYRO_A_RATE_SATURATION
telemetry.description: This channel is the SSIRU A Gyro A RS422 bit for Rate Saturation. This bit shall be set to a value of logic 1 when the rate capability of the FTR mode has been exceeded. When set, Gyro A's mode of operation will be whole angle saturated (WAS). For SSIRU, this transition is set to occur at 9.5 deg/sec. Transition from WAS to FTR will automatically occur when the input rate has dropped to less than 3.5 deg/sec. (F7 Word 8)

telemetry.name: JOI_BEHAVIOR_STATE
telemetry.description: The status of the JOI behavior (Per JOI FDD - D-XXXX) Identifying each bubble in the sate diagram.

telemetry.name: JOI_DELTAV_TO_GO
telemetry.description: This Channel indicates the deltaV Magnitude remaining. Should match GNC tlm for deltaV_to_go, but maintained separately

telemetry.name: JOI_IN_PROGRESS
telemetry.description: This Channel indicates if the JOI In Progress flag has been set to true

telemetry.name: JOI_TOTAL_BURN_PROGRESS
telemetry.description: Amount of burn completed. Do_JOI command value minus JOI_DeltaV_to_go

telemetry.name: JOI_RESTART_COUNT
telemetry.description: Number of times JOI_Behavior_Executing entered from anomalous state

telemetry.name: JOI_WETMASS
telemetry.description: the wetmass computation that is being computed and stored in REU shared

telemetry.name: SYS_JOI_START_TIME
telemetry.description: The telemetered version of the Sys_JOI start time which is set with the DO_JOI Command

telemetry.name: JOI_TOTAL_BURN_PROGRESS_PERCENT
telemetry.description: This is a percentage value of completeness of the JOI burn. Value is (Commanded JOI Magnitude - JOI DeltaV to go ) / Commanded JOI Magnitude * 100.

telemetry.name: JOI_CRIT_MODE
telemetry.description: Specifies if the JOI behavior will run in Demo mode or Critical Mode

telemetry.name: MON_JOI_MAX_TIMEOUT_FLAG
telemetry.description: True if JOI duration exceeds the total MAX timeout parameter (0x0F140011), False otherwise.

telemetry.name: LNCH_BEHAVIOR_STATUS
telemetry.description: The status of the launch behavior (Per Launch FDD - D-56158)

telemetry.name: LNCH_BEHAVIOR_STAGE
telemetry.description: This channel contains the stage of the launch behavior (per Launch FDD D-56158).

telemetry.name: LNCH_LVSEP_STATUS
telemetry.description: This channel contains the status of the spacecraft separation from the launch vehicle

telemetry.name: LNCH_HDRM_CUTS
telemetry.description: This channel contains the number of Hold Down Release Mechanisms (HDRMs) that have been actuated to deploy the solar arrays.

telemetry.name: LNCH_DEPLOYMENT_STARTED
telemetry.description:
This channel contains telemetry about whether the solar array deployment has started (per Launch FDD D-56158).
lnch_control pulls this value from the REU shared memory. GNC will query this SBS state to know the state and use that to determine weather to use the stowed controller or the supersafe controller.

telemetry.name: LNCH_MX_MSA
telemetry.description: This channel contains the status of microswitch A on the negative X solar array wing.

telemetry.name: LNCH_MX_MSB
telemetry.description: This channel contains the status of microswitch B on the negative X solar array wing.

telemetry.name: LNCH_PX_MSA
telemetry.description: This channel contains the status of microswitch A on the positive X solar array wing.

telemetry.name: LNCH_PX_MSB
telemetry.description: This channel contains the status of microswitch B on the positive X solar array wing.
