telemetry.name: MAG_OP_STATUS
telemetry.description: Consists of the Operational Status bits in the ECM H&S packet. Includes the number of subseconds that have elapsed since the last time sync signal was received, Interface Type, Selected Interface, Busy bit, Panic bit, and Instrument Mode. {FG1 status, FG2 status, FG3 status}. 0 = IDLE mode, 1-7 = MEASUREMENT Mode (7 = all 3 FGs on in measurement mode)

telemetry.name: MAG_CMD_STATUS
telemetry.description: Consists of the Command Status bits in the ECM H&S packet. Includes command accepted overflow, command accepted counter, command executed overflow, command executed counter, command rejected overflow, and command rejected counter.

telemetry.name: MAG_CMD_HIST_0
telemetry.description: Consists of the history of the last Command in the ECM H&S packet. This includes: Least significant five bits of sequence count of the last received command (5-bit) Command status code of last received command (3-bit) Opcode of last command (16-bit integer)

telemetry.name: MAG_CMD_HIST_1
telemetry.description: Consists of the history of the second to last Command in the ECM H&S packet. This includes: Least significant five bits of sequence count of the second to last received command (5-bit) Command status code of the second to last received command (3-bit) Opcode of the second to last command (16-bit integer)

telemetry.name: MAG_CMD_HIST_2
telemetry.description: Consists of the history of the third to last Command in the ECM H&S packet. This includes: Least significant five bits of sequence count of the third to last received command (5-bit) Command status code of the third to last received command (3-bit) Opcode of the third to last command (16-bit integer)

telemetry.name: MAG_CMD_HIST_3
telemetry.description: Consists of the history of the fourth to last Command in the ECM H&S packet. This includes: Least significant five bits of sequence count of the fourth to last received command (5-bit) Command status code of the fourth to last received command (3-bit) Opcode of the fourth to last command (16-bit integer)

telemetry.name: MAG_CMD_HIST_4
telemetry.description: Consists of the history of the fifth to last Command in the ECM H&S packet. This includes: Least significant five bits of sequence count of the fifth to last received command (5-bit) Command status code of the fifth to last received command (3-bit) Opcode of the fifth to last command (16-bit integer)

telemetry.name: MAG_UART_ERROR_COUNT
telemetry.description: Consists of the ECM UART Error Count in the ECM H&S packet. (bits 296:303)

telemetry.name: MAG_INSTR_TIME_SEC
telemetry.description: Instrument time - seconds (bits 80:111)

telemetry.name: MAG_INSTR_TIME_SUBSEC
telemetry.description: Instrument time - sub seconds (bits 112:127)

telemetry.name: MAG_FAULT_RESPONSE_REQUEST
telemetry.description: Bits (318:319) - Mag power down request, Mag restart request

telemetry.name: MAG_CLOCKS_SINCE_LAST_1PPS
telemetry.description: ECM Clock last 1PPS (bits 344:367)

telemetry.name: MAG_FG1_HTR_AVG
telemetry.description: ECM Flux Gate 1 op heater control configuration and status (bits 368:391)

telemetry.name: MAG_FG2_HTR_AVG
telemetry.description: ECM Flux Gate 2 op heater control configuration and status (bits 392:415)

telemetry.name: MAG_FG3_HTR_AVG

telemetry.name: MASP_OP_STATUS
telemetry.description: Consists of the Operational Status bits in the MASPEX H&S packet. Includes the number of subseconds that have elapsed since the last time sync signal was received, Interface Type, Selected Interface, Busy bit, Panic bit, and Instrument Mode.

telemetry.name: MASP_CMD_STATUS
telemetry.description: Consists of the Command Status bits in the MASPEX H&S packet. Includes command accepted overflow, command accepted counter, command executed overflow, command executed counter, command rejected overflow, and command rejected counter.

telemetry.name: MASP_CMD_HIST_0
telemetry.description: Consists of the history of the last Command in the MASPEX H&S packet. This includes: Least significant five bits of sequence count of the last received command (5-bit) Command status code of last received command (3-bit) Opcode of last command (16-bit integer)

telemetry.name: MASP_CMD_HIST_1
telemetry.description: Consists of the history of the second to last Command in the MASPEX H&S packet. This includes: Least significant five bits of sequence count of the second to last received command (5-bit) Command status code of the second to last received command (3-bit) Opcode of the second to last command (16-bit integer). This channel is only populated when MASPEX is running App SW. The associated field in the H&S packet is blank (zeros) when MASPEX is running Boot SW.

telemetry.name: MASP_CMD_HIST_2
telemetry.description: Consists of the history of the third to last Command in the MASPEX H&S packet. This includes: Least significant five bits of sequence count of the third to last received command (5-bit) Command status code of the third to last received command (3-bit) Opcode of the third to last command (16-bit integer). This channel is only populated when MASPEX is running App SW. The associated field in the H&S packet is blank (zeros) when MASPEX is running Boot SW.

telemetry.name: MASP_CMD_HIST_3

This includes: Least significant five bits of sequence count of the fourth to last received command (5-bit) Command status code of the fourth to last received command (3-bit) Opcode of the fourth to last command (16-bit integer). This channel is only populated when MASPEX is running App SW. The associated field in the H&S packet is blank (zeros) when MASPEX is running Boot SW.

telemetry.name: MASP_CMD_HIST_4
telemetry.description: Consists of the history of the fifth to last Command in the MASPEX H&S packet. This includes: Least significant five bits of sequence count of the fifth to last received command (5-bit) Command status code of the fifth to last received command (3-bit) Opcode of the fifth to last command (16-bit integer). This channel is only populated when MASPEX is running App SW. The associated field in the H&S packet is blank (zeros) when MASPEX is running Boot SW.

telemetry.name: MISE_OP_STATUS
telemetry.description: Consists of the Operational Status bits in the MISE H&S packet. Includes the number of subseconds that have elapsed since the last time sync signal was received, Interface Type, Selected Interface, Busy bit, Panic bit, and Instrument Mode.

telemetry.name: MISE_CMD_STATUS
telemetry.description: Consists of the Command Status bits in the MISE H&S packet. Includes command accepted overflow, command accepted counter, command executed overflow, command executed counter, command rejected overflow, and command rejected counter.

telemetry.name: MISE_CMD_HIST_0
telemetry.description: Consists of the history of the last Command in the MISE H&S packet. This includes: Least significant five bits of sequence count of the last received command (5-bit) Command status code of last received command (3-bit) Opcode of last command (16-bit integer)

telemetry.name: MISE_CMD_HIST_1
telemetry.description: Consists of the history of the second to last Command in the MISE H&S packet. This includes: Least significant five bits of sequence count of the second to last received command (5-bit) Command status code of the second to last received command (3-bit) Opcode of the second to last command (16-bit integer)

telemetry.name: MISE_CMD_HIST_2
telemetry.description: Consists of the history of the third to last Command in the MISE H&S packet. This includes: Least significant five bits of sequence count of the third to last received command (5-bit) Command status code of the third to last received command (3-bit) Opcode of the third to last command (16-bit integer)

telemetry.name: MISE_CMD_HIST_3
telemetry.description: Consists of the history of the fourth to last Command in the MISE H&S packet. This includes: Least significant five bits of sequence count of the fourth to last received command (5-bit) Command status code of the fourth to last received command (3-bit) Opcode of the fourth to last command (16-bit integer)

telemetry.name: MISE_CMD_HIST_4
telemetry.description: Consists of the history of the fifth to last Command in the MISE H&S packet. This includes: Least significant five bits of sequence count of the fifth to last received command (5-bit) Command status code of the fifth to last received command (3-bit) Opcode of the fifth to last command (16-bit integer)

telemetry.name: MISE_SPW_STATUS
telemetry.description: Consists of the MISE SpaceWire Error Count in the MISE H&S packet.

telemetry.name: MISE_ALARM_STATUS
telemetry.description: Includes latest alarm ID, alarm type, count of alarms since powered up, and value associated with alarm.

telemetry.name: MISE_AUTONOMY_RSP_STATUS
telemetry.description: Includes Autonomy response status bits and reserved 6 bits

telemetry.name: MISE_CEU_POWER_REQUEST
telemetry.description: Request to update CEU ON or Off. 0 = No change, 1 = CEU OFF, 2 = CEU ON, 3 = No change

telemetry.description: Includes IFC +6.5V voltage, and IFC -6.5V voltage

telemetry.name: PIMS_U_OP_STATUS
telemetry.description: Consists of the Operational Status bits in the PIMS-Upper H&S packet. Includes the number of subseconds that have elapsed since the last time sync signal was received, Interface Type, Selected Interface, Busy bit, Panic bit, and Instrument Mode.

telemetry.name: PIMS_U_CMD_STATUS
telemetry.description: Consists of the Command Status bits in the PIMS-Upper H&S packet. Includes command accepted overflow, command accepted counter, command executed overflow, command executed counter, command rejected overflow, and command rejected counter.

telemetry.name: PIMS_U_CMD_HIST_0
telemetry.description: Consists of the history of the last Command in the PIMS-Upper H&S packet. This includes: Least significant five bits of sequence count of the last received command (5-bit) Command status code of last received command (3-bit) Opcode of last command (16-bit integer)

telemetry.name: PIMS_U_CMD_HIST_1
telemetry.description: Consists of the history of the second to last Command in the PIMS-Upper H&S packet. This includes: Least significant five bits of sequence count of the second to last received command (5-bit) Command status code of the second to last received command (3-bit) Opcode of the second to last command (16-bit integer)

telemetry.name: PIMS_U_CMD_HIST_2
telemetry.description: Consists of the history of the third to last Command in the PIMS-Upper H&S packet. This includes: Least significant five bits of sequence count of the third to last received command (5-bit) Command status code of the third to last received command (3-bit) Opcode of the third to last command (16-bit integer)

telemetry.name: PIMS_U_CMD_HIST_3
telemetry.description: Consists of the history of the fourth to last Command in the PIMS-Upper H&S packet. This includes: Least significant five bits of sequence count of the fourth to last received command (5-bit) Command status code of the fourth to last received command (3-bit) Opcode of the fourth to last command (16-bit integer)

telemetry.name: PIMS_U_CMD_HIST_4
telemetry.description: Consists of the history of the fifth to last Command in the PIMS-Upper H&S packet. This includes: Least significant five bits of sequence count of the fifth to last received command (5-bit) Command status code of the fifth to last received command (3-bit) Opcode of the fifth to last command (16-bit integer)

telemetry.name: PIMS_U_UART_STATUS
telemetry.description: Consists of the PIMS-Upper UART Error Count in the PIMS-Upper H&S packet.

telemetry.name: PIMS_U_ALARM_STATUS
telemetry.description: Includes the last alarm ID, alarm type, alarm count, and user-defined alarm data

telemetry.name: PIMS_U_APP_IMG_STATUS
telemetry.description: Includes the status of the two application images.

telemetry.name: PIMS_U_LOOP_UTIL_COUNTER
telemetry.description: Number of times through main loop in the last second

telemetry.name: PIMS_U_MEM_TEST_RESULT
telemetry.description: Memory test result

telemetry.name: PIMS_U_LAST_STM
telemetry.description: SCLK of the last spacecraft time message received

telemetry.name: PIMS_U_STM_DELTA
telemetry.description: Time between when the MSCLK is zeroed and when the H&S Packet is generated.

telemetry.name: PIMS_U_MET_STATUS
telemetry.description: Includes the number of spacecraft time messages received since power on, and the mission elapsed time (MET) status

telemetry.name: PIMS_U_CMD_EXEC_TIME_SECONDS
telemetry.description: Execution time of the last command (full seconds)

telemetry.name: PIMS_U_CMD_EXEC_TIME_SUBSECONDS
telemetry.description: Execution time of the last command (sub-seconds)

telemetry.name: PIMS_U_1P5V_CEU_CURRENT
telemetry.description: The uncalibrated reading of current on the +1.5V power supply. This channel provides telemetry on the current of the power supplies used by digital components on the CEU board. (Value is not populated in boot mode)

telemetry.name: PIMS_U_3P6V_CEU_VOLTAGE
telemetry.description: The uncalibrated reading of voltage on the +3.6V power supply. This channel provides telemetry on the voltage of the other power supplies on the CEU board. Current monitors do not exist for these supplies. (Value is not populated in boot mode)

telemetry.name: PIMS_U_15V_PWR_ANALOG_CURRENT
telemetry.description: The uncalibrated reading of current on the +15V power supply. When the instrument is performing HV sweeps, it is anticipated that the current draw of this power supply will increase. This channel provides telemetry on the voltage of the power supply used by the HVPS board and CEU board to generate voltages on the Faraday Cup (+15V), and a direct monitor of the Suppressor Voltage output on the CEU board. (Value is not populated in boot mode)

telemetry.name: PIMS_U_2V_VOLTAGE
telemetry.description: The uncalibrated reading of voltage on the +2V power supply. This channel provides telemetry on the voltage of the other power supplies on the CEU board. Current monitors do not exist for these supplies. (Value is not populated in boot mode)

telemetry.name: PIMS_U_SUPPRESSOR_VOLTAGE
telemetry.description: The uncalibrated reading of the Suppressor voltage circuit output. This can be used to directly ascertain the real-time (1Hz) voltage of the Suppressor grid, with appropriate hardware calibration functions. This channel provides telemetry on the voltage of the power supply used by the HVPS board and CEU board to generate voltages on the Faraday Cup (+15V), and a direct monitor of the Suppressor Voltage output on the CEU board. (Value is not populated in boot mode)

telemetry.name: PIMS_U_15V_PWR_VOLTAGE
telemetry.description: The uncalibrated reading of voltage on the +15V power supply. This channel provides telemetry on the voltage of the power supply used by the HVPS board and CEU board to generate voltages on the Faraday Cup (+15V), and a direct monitor of the Suppressor Voltage output on the CEU board. (Value is not populated in boot mode)

telemetry.name: PIMS_U_1P5V_CEU_VOLTAGE
telemetry.description: The uncalibrated reading of voltage on the +1.5V power supply. This channel provides telemetry on the voltage of the power supplies used by digital components on the CEU board. (Value is not populated in boot mode)

telemetry.name: PIMS_U_HVPS_LOW_VOLTAGE_SENSE
telemetry.description: Measures the output of the low voltage branch of circuitry on the HVPS board. This can be used to ascertain the real-time (measured at 1Hz) voltage of the LV grid, with appropriate hardware calibration functions. (Value is not populated in boot mode)

telemetry.name: PIMS_U_HVPS_LV_BULK_SENSE
telemetry.description: Measures the output of the LV bulk circuitry on the HVPS board. (Value is not populated in boot mode)

telemetry.name: PIMS_U_HVPS_BOARD_TEMP
telemetry.description: The uncalibrated reading of the S-311-P-18 thermistor on the HVPS board. This channel describes the temperature of the HVPS board.

telemetry.name: PIMS_U_CEU_BOARD_TEMP
telemetry.description: Channel 22 is the uncalibrated reading of the S-311-P-18 thermistor on the Event side of the CEU board. Channel 23 is the uncalibrated reading of the S-311-P-18 thermistor on the LVPS side of the CEU board. These channels describe the temperature of the HVPS and CEU boards. (Value is not populated in boot mode)

telemetry.name: PIMS_U_RADMON_VOLTAGE
telemetry.description: Channel 24 is the output of the first RadMON FET. Channel 25 is the output of the second RadMON FET. These channels show the readings of the RadMON FETs on the CEU board. This telemetry is stale unless the RadMON Enable bits are 1 in the Hardware Status section of the same packet. (Value is not populated in boot mode)

telemetry.name: PIMS_L_OP_STATUS
telemetry.description: Consists of the Operational Status bits in the PIMS-Lower H&S packet. Includes the number of subseconds that have elapsed since the last time sync signal was received, Interface Type, Selected Interface, Busy bit, Panic bit, and Instrument Mode.

telemetry.name: PIMS_L_CMD_STATUS
telemetry.description: Consists of the Command Status bits in the PIMS-Lower H&S packet. Includes command accepted overflow, command accepted counter, command executed overflow, command executed counter, command rejected overflow, and command rejected counter.

telemetry.name: PIMS_L_CMD_HIST_0
telemetry.description: Consists of the history of the last Command in the PIMS-Lower H&S packet. This includes: Least significant five bits of sequence count of the last received command (5-bit) Command status code of last received command (3-bit) Opcode of last command (16-bit integer)

telemetry.name: PIMS_L_CMD_HIST_1
telemetry.description: Consists of the history of the second to last Command in the PIMS-Lower H&S packet. This includes: Least significant five bits of sequence count of the second to last received command (5-bit) Command status code of the second to last received command (3-bit) Opcode of the second to last command (16-bit integer)

telemetry.name: PIMS_L_CMD_HIST_3
telemetry.description: Consists of the history of the fourth to last Command in the PIMS-Lower H&S packet. telemetry.description: Total number of free blocks (commands), left in macro storage. This number is limited by the total macro non-volatile storage. (Value is not populated in boot mode)

telemetry.description: Last executed macro ID (Value is not populated in boot mode)

telemetry.name: PIMS_U_HV_SAFE_PIN_STATUS
telemetry.description: HV safe pin shorted (safing plug status) (Value is not populated in boot mode)

telemetry.name: PIMS_U_CEU_EVENT_BOARD_TEMP
telemetry.description: Uncalibrated reading of the S-311-P-18 thermistor on the Event side of the CEU board. This channel describes the temperature of CEU boards. (Value is not populated in boot mode)

telemetry.name: PIMS_U_LVPS_BOARD_TEMP
telemetry.description: Uncalibrated reading of the S-311-P-18 thermistor on the LVPS side of the CEU board. This channel describes the temperature of the CEU board. (Value is not populated in boot mode)

telemetry.name: PIMS_U_RADMON_FET_0_VOLTAGE
telemetry.description: The output of the first RadMON FET. This channel shows the readings of the RadMON FETs on the CEU board. This telemetry is stale unless the RadMON Enable bits are 1 in the Hardware Status section of the same packet. (Value is not populated in boot mode)

telemetry.name: PIMS_U_RADMON_FET_1_VOLTAGE

telemetry.name: PROP_MEDIAN_FUEL_TANK_PRESSURE
telemetry.description: This channel is the median of the 3 HEALTHY and VALID pressure transducers (PT10, PT11,PT12) measurements for the Oxidizer propellant tank as reported by the prime PME. If any of the PT's are invalid or sick, this channel reflects the median of the remaining healthy and valid PT's. The channel uses on board conversion of DN-EU to report measurements in psi units.

telemetry.name: PROP_MEDIAN_OX_TANK_PRESSURE
telemetry.description: This channel is the median of the 3 HEALTHY and VALID pressure transducers (PT03, PT04,PT05) measurements for the Oxidizer propellant tank as reported by the prime PME. If any of the PT's are invalid or sick, this channel reflects the median of the remaining healthy and valid PT'sThe channel uses on board conversion of DN-EU to report measurements in psi units.

telemetry.name: PWR_PBC_FPGA_1_TLM01_TLM00
telemetry.description: This channel contains the PBC FPGA-1 telemetry for registers TLM01 (bits 31. . .16) and TLM00 (bits 15. . .0) (bits ordered most to least significant) which includes FPGA Status and FPGA ID (refer to D-56604 PBC IICD and D-56651 PBC FPGA Specification).

telemetry.name: PWR_PBC_FPGA_1_TLM03_TLM02
telemetry.description: This channel contains the PBC FPGA-1 telemetry for registers TLM03 (bits 31. . .16) and TLM02 (bits 15. . .0) (bits ordered most to least significant) which includes FPGA Status (refer to D-56604 PBC IICD and D-56651 PBC FPGA Specification).

telemetry.name: PWR_PBC_FPGA_1_TLM05_TLM04
telemetry.description: This channel contains the PBC FPGA-1 telemetry for registers TLM05 (bits 31...16) and TLM04 (bits 15. . .0) (bits ordered most to least significant) which includes RSB Status (refer to D-56604 PBC IICD and D-56651 PBC FPGA Specification).

telemetry.name: PWR_PBC_FPGA_1_TLM07_TLM06
telemetry.description: This channel contains the PBC FPGA-1 telemetry for registers TLM07 (bits 31...16) and TLM06 (bits 15. . .0) (bits ordered most to least significant) which includes RSB Command Counts (refer to D-56604 PBC IICD and D-56651 PBC FPGA Specification).

telemetry.name: PWR_PBC_FPGA_1_TLM09_TLM08
telemetry.description: This channel contains the PBC FPGA-1 telemetry for registers TLM09 (bits 31...16) and TLM08 (bits 15. . .0) (bits ordered most to least significant) which includes PID (K[p] and K[i]) variables (refer to D-56604 PBC IICD and D-56651 PBC FPGA Specification).

telemetry.name: PWR_PBC_FPGA_1_TLM11_TLM10

telemetry.name: PWR_PBC_MEDIAN_BUS_VOLTAGE
telemetry.description: The channel contains the median of the available bus voltage measurements. Here are the Channel ID's of the power bus voltage from each PBC FCR: PWR-0030, PWR-0046, PWR-0062 (PWR_PBC_FPGA_n_BUS_VOLTAGE). Refer to D-56604 PBC IICD Table 10 (S/C Bus Voltage). If PBC FPGA ID = 0xDEAD, ignore associated telemetry. FSW will choose the controlling spacecraft bus voltage telemetry based on the following conditions: a. If three PBC FPGAs are healthy and valid, FSW will choose the middle value. b. If two PBC FPGAs are healthy and valid, FSW will take the mean of those 2 values. c. If one PBC FPGA is healthy and valid, FSW will use the one available value.

telemetry.name: PWR_PBC_MEDIAN_PX_SA_WING_CURR
telemetry.description: The channel contains the median of the available PX solar array wing current measurements. Here are the Channel ID's of the PX solar array wing current channels: PWR-0033, PWR-0049, PWR-0065 (PWR_PBC_FPGA_n_PX_SA_CURR). Refer to D-56604 PBC IICD Table 10 (Solar Array Wing A Current). If PBC FPGA ID = 0xDEAD, ignore associated telemetry. FSW will choose the controlling spacecraft bus voltage telemetry based on the following conditions: a. If three PBC FPGAs are healthy and valid, FSW will choose the middle value. b. If two PBC FPGAs are healthy and valid, FSW will take the mean of those 2 values. c. If one PBC FPGA is healthy and valid, FSW will use the one available value.

telemetry.name: PWR_PBC_MEDIAN_MX_SA_WING_CURR
telemetry.description: The channel contains the median of the available MX solar array wing current measurements. Here are the Channel ID's of the MX solar array wing current channels from each PBC FCR: PWR-0034, PWR-0050, PWR-0066 (PWR_PBC_FPGA_n_MX_SA_CURR). Refer to D-56604 PBC IICD Table 10 (Solar Array Wing B Current). If PBC FPGA ID = 0xDEAD, ignore associated telemetry. FSW will choose the controlling spacecraft bus voltage telemetry based on the following conditions: a. If three PBC FPGAs are healthy and valid, FSW will choose the middle value. b. If two PBC FPGAs are healthy and valid, FSW will take the mean of those 2 values. c. If one PBC FPGA is healthy and valid, FSW will use the one available value.

telemetry.name: PWR_PBC_MEDIAN_PWR_BUS_LO_SIDE_VOLT_WRT_CHASSIS
telemetry.description: The channel contains the median of the available power bus low side voltage measurements with respect to chassis. Here are the Channel ID's of the power bus voltage from each PBC FCR: PWR-0082, PWR-0098, PWR-0114 (PWR_PBC_FPGA_n_PWR_BUS_LO_SIDE_VOLT_WRT_CHASSIS). Refer to D-56604 PBC IICD Table 11 (Power Bus Low Side Voltage wrt Chassis). If PBC FPGA ID = 0xDEAD, ignore associated telemetry. FSW will choose the controlling spacecraft bus voltage telemetry based on the following conditions: a. If three PBC FPGAs are healthy and valid, FSW will choose the middle value. b. If two PBC FPGAs are healthy and valid, FSW will take the mean of those 2 values. c. If one PBC FPGA is healthy and valid, FSW will use the one available value.

telemetry.name: PWR_PBC_MEDIAN_SA_PWR_CONV_1_CURR
telemetry.description: The channel contains the median of the available solar array power converter 1 current measurements. Here are the Channel ID's of the solar array power converter 1 current measurements from each PBC FCR: PWR-0040, PWR-0056, PWR-0072 (PWR_PBC_FPGA_n_SA_PWR_CONV_1_CURR). Refer to D-56604 PBC IICD Table 10 (Solar Array Power Converter Current 1). If PBC FPGA ID = 0xDEAD, ignore associated telemetry. FSW will choose the controlling solar array power converter 1 current telemetry based on the following conditions: a. If three PBC FPGAs are healthy and valid, FSW will choose the middle value. b. If two PBC FPGAs are healthy and valid, FSW will take the mean of those 2 values. c. If one PBC FPGA is healthy and valid, FSW will use the one available value.

telemetry.name: PWR_PBC_MEDIAN_SA_PWR_CONV_2_CURR

Here are the Channel ID's of the solar array power converter 2 current measurements from each PBC FCR: PWR-0041, PWR-0057, PWR-0073 (PWR_PBC_FPGA_n_SA_PWR_CONV_2_CURR). Refer to D-56604 PBC IICD Table 10 (Solar Array Power Converter Current 2). If PBC FPGA ID = 0xDEAD, ignore associated telemetry. FSW will choose the controlling solar array power converter 2 current telemetry based on the following conditions: a. If three PBC FPGAs are healthy and valid, FSW will choose the middle value. b. If two PBC FPGAs are healthy and valid, FSW will take the mean of those 2 values. c. If one PBC FPGA is healthy and valid, FSW will use the one available value.

telemetry.name: PWR_PBC_MEDIAN_NET_BATT_CURR
telemetry.description: The channel contains the median of the available net battery current measurements. Here are the Channel ID's of the net battery current from each PBC FCR: PWR-0031, PWR-0047, PWR-0063 (PWR_PBC_FPGA_n_NET_BATT_CURR). Refer to D-56604 PBC IICD Table 10 (Net Battery Current). If PBC FPGA ID = 0xDEAD, ignore associated telemetry. FSW will choose the controlling spacecraft bus voltage telemetry based on the following conditions: a. If three PBC FPGAs are healthy and valid, FSW will choose the middle value. b. If two PBC FPGAs are healthy and valid, FSW will take the mean of those 2 values. c. If one PBC FPGA is healthy and valid, FSW will use the one available value.

telemetry.name: SFP_MON_PROP_LEAK_OX_TANK_PRESS_CORR_INITIAL_PRESS
telemetry.description:
This is the channel created to define the temperature corrected initial pressure used by the leak detection monitor.
Channel is valid only if all required tlm and P_OX_Initial is valid.
P_OX_Initial is valid only when the following conditions are met: [P_OX_Intial can be valid for at most MAX_TIME_P_INITIAL_VALID_THRESH;APC is not active; PROP_MEDIAN_OX_TANK_PRESSURE is valid; GROUND_ENABLE is enabled; SFP_MON_PROP_LEAK_OX_TANK_TIME_DISS_TRANSIENTS_THRSH after completion of do_safing; In RCS system mode (including Sys_safe_standard and sys_safe_uv)]
P_OX_Initial=MEAN(SFP_MON_PROP_LEAK_OX_TANK_PRESS_TIME_INIT_PRESS,PROP_MEDIAN_OX_TANK_PRESSURE);
Note: P_OX_Initial is only valid after SFP_MON_PROP_LEAK_OX_TANK_PRESS_TIME_INIT_PRESS of valid PROP_MEDIAN_OX_TANK_PRESSURE. ;
Note: P_OX_Initial should be evaluated when all validity conditions are met and P_OX_Initial is presently invalid.
When P_OX_Initial is valid collect and save value of (THRM_OX_PROP_TNK_UPR_ZN_CTRL_TEMP) as T_OX_Initial
SFP_MON_PROP_LEAK_OX_TANK_PRESS_CORR_INITIAL_PRESS=P_OX_Initial*((THRM_OX_PROP_TNK_UPR_ZN_CTRL_TEMP)/T_OX_initial)

telemetry.name: SFP_MON_PROP_LEAK_FL_TANK_PRESS_CORR_INITIAL_PRESS
telemetry.description:
This is the channel created to define the temperature corrected initial pressure used by the leak detection monitor.
Channel is valid only if all required tlm and P_FL_Initial is valid.
P_FL_Initial is valid only when the following conditions are met: [P_FL_Intial can be valid for at most MAX_TIME_P_INITIAL_VALID_THRESH;APC is not active; PROP_MEDIAN_FUEL_TANK_PRESSURE is valid; GROUND_ENABLE is enabled; SFP_MON_PROP_LEAK_FL_TANK_TIME_DISS_TRANSIENTS_THRSH after completion of do_safing; In RCS system mode (including Sys_safe_standard and Sys_safe_UV)]
P_FL_Initial=MEAN(SFP_MON_PROP_LEAK_FL_TANK_PRESS_TIME_INIT_PRESS,PROP_MEDIAN_FUEL_TANK_PRESSURE);
Note: P_FL_Initial is only valid after SFP_MON_PROP_LEAK_FL_TANK_PRESS_TIME_INIT_PRESS of valid PROP_MEDIAN_FUEL_TANK_PRESSURE. ;
Note: P_FL_Initial should be evaluated when all validity conditions are met and P_FL_Initial is presently invalid.
When P_FL_Initial is valid collect and save value of (THRM_FU_PROP_TNK_UPR_ZN_CTRL_TEMP) as T_FL_Initial
SFP_MON_PROP_LEAK_FL_TANK_PRESS_CORR_INITIAL_PRESS=P_FL_Initial*((THRM_FU_PROP_TNK_UPR_ZN_CTRL_TEMP)/T_FL_initial)

telemetry.name: SM_SYSTEM_MODE
telemetry.description: The current system mode.

telemetry.name: SM_TARGET_SYSTEM_MODE
telemetry.description: This channel contains the shared memory value of the target system mode that the spacecraft will boot to following a reset. Note that this reflects the current value used in FSW which is updated when it is changed (and not the resident value in shared memory).

telemetry.name: SUDA_OP_STATUS
telemetry.description: Consists of the Operational Status bits in the SUDA H&S packet. Includes the number of subseconds that have elapsed since the last time sync signal was received, Interface Type, Selected Interface, Busy bit, Panic bit, and Instrument Mode.

telemetry.name: SUDA_CMD_STATUS
telemetry.description: Consists of the Command Status bits in the SUDA H&S packet. Includes command accepted overflow, command accepted counter, command executed overflow, command executed counter, command rejected overflow, and command rejected counter.

telemetry.name: SUDA_CMD_HIST_0
telemetry.description: Consists of the history of the last Command in the SUDA H&S packet. This includes: Least significant five bits of sequence count of the last received command (5-bit) Command status code of last received command (3-bit) Opcode of last command (16-bit integer)

telemetry.name: SUDA_CMD_HIST_1
telemetry.description: Consists of the history of the second to last Command in the SUDA H&S packet. This includes: Least significant five bits of sequence count of the second to last received command (5-bit) Command status code of the second to last received command (3-bit) Opcode of the second to last command (16-bit integer)

telemetry.name: SUDA_CMD_HIST_2
telemetry.description: Consists of the history of the third to last Command in the SUDA H&S packet. This includes: Least significant five bits of sequence count of the third to last received command (5-bit) Command status code of the third to last received command (3-bit) Opcode of the third to last command (16-bit integer)

telemetry.name: SUDA_CMD_HIST_3
telemetry.description: Consists of the history of the fourth to last Command in the SUDA H&S packet. This includes: Least significant five bits of sequence count of the fourth to last received command (5-bit) Command status code of the fourth to last received command (3-bit) Opcode of the fourth to last command (16-bit integer)

telemetry.name: SUDA_CMD_HIST_4
telemetry.description: Consists of the history of the fifth to last Command in the SUDA H&S packet. This includes: Least significant five bits of sequence count of the fifth to last received command (5-bit) Command status code of the fifth to last received command (3-bit) Opcode of the fifth to last command (16-bit integer)

telemetry.name: SUDA_SPW_STATUS
telemetry.description: Consists of the SUDA SpaceWire Error Count in the SUDA H&S packet.

telemetry.name: SUDA_SPW_DETAILED_STATUS
telemetry.description: Includes detailed SpaceWire status bits.

telemetry.name: SUDA_TLM_PKT_STATUS

telemetry.name: SUDA_STM_STATUS
telemetry.description: Reports the count number of valid STMs received, identifies overdue SpaceWire Time Code, identifies overdue Spacecraft Time Message.

telemetry.name: SUDA_QUICKBOOT_STATUS
telemetry.description: Reports on status of quick boot funtionality. Reports on various possible error statuses: Valid Flash Table not found during memory initialization, Valid Persistent Table not found during memory initialization, Valid Parameter Table not found during memory initialization, Valid Operational FSW image not found during memory initialization, Error encountered when copying OperFSW image during quickboot.

telemetry.name: SUDA_MEM_OPS_STATUS
telemetry.description: Includes count of successful memory operations (no rollover), count of failed memory operations (no rollover), counts successful packet transmissions

telemetry.name: SUDA_LST_DIR_READ_CMD_VAL

telemetry.name: TEL_RF_SWITCH_STAT
telemetry.description: This telemetry channel includes RF Switch states for all RF switches, a total of 28 signals for the CTS, WTS-1, WTS-2, WTS-3, WTS-4 (each with 2 possible positions), SP3T1, SP3T-2, SP3T-3, (each with 3 possible positions) going to REU-A and REU-B. See 002-006-021 through 002-006-056 in the Electrical Flight System Function and Resource Mapping List. Note that the CTS and WTS position telemetry is not cross-strapped to the REUs. Each switch position is its own signal. For any given switch position, a 1 indicates the switch is in this position and a 0 indicates it is not. So for example, if WTS-1 is in Position 1, WTS-1 Pos 1 is high and WTS-1 Pos 2 is low. Some states are indeterminate and we cannot tell what position the switch is in.

telemetry.name: TEL_RADIO_A_UNEXPECTED_RESETS
telemetry.description: Number of unexpected resets from Radio A. This channel should initially be set to zero and should be incremented every time that RADIO.RESET_SRC is cleared. This channel should clear on ECE reset (POR or not).

telemetry.name: TEL_RADIO_B_UNEXPECTED_RESETS
telemetry.description: Number of unexpected resets from Radio B. This channel should initially be set to zero and should be incremented every time that RADIO.RESET_SRC is cleared. This channel should clear on ECE reset (POR or not).

telemetry.name: TIME_SCLK_SECONDS
telemetry.description: Spacecraft Clock value.

telemetry.name: TIME_PCI_DFT_RTI_TO_DEADP
telemetry.description: PCI drift for RTI-DEADP mode. The number of PCI cycles read for this mode.

telemetry.name: TIME_PCI_DFT_RTI_TO_RTI
telemetry.description: PCI drift for RTI-RTI mode. Number of PCI cycles read for this mode.

telemetry.name: TIME_MCLK_A_SECONDS
telemetry.description: Current mission clock value from REU-A; in seconds.

telemetry.name: TIME_MCLK_B_SECONDS
telemetry.description: Current mission clock value from REU-B; in seconds.

telemetry.name: TIME_MCLKS_MISCOMPARE_ERR_CNT
telemetry.description: Error count for MCLK-to-MCLK mis-comparing (not within the parameterized threshold) during time initialization.

telemetry.name: TIME_MCLK_A_TO_SAVED_TIM_MISCOMPARE_ERR_CNT
telemetry.description: Error count for MCLK_A-to-SAVED_TIME miscomparing (not within the parameterized threshold) during time initialization.

telemetry.name: TIME_MCLK_B_TO_SAVED_TIM_MISCOMPARE_ERR_CNT
telemetry.description: Error count for MCLK_B-to-SAVED_TIME miscomparing (not within the parameterized threshold) during time initialization.

telemetry.name: TIME_BOTH_MCLKS_BAD_ERR_CNT
telemetry.description: Error count for both MCLKS not available/usable during time initializaton.

telemetry.name: TIME_MCLK_REU_A_AUTO_SYNC_CNT
telemetry.description: Count for the number of times the MCLK in REU-A has been synched with SCLK autonomously.

telemetry.name: TIME_MCLK_REU_B_AUTO_SYNC_CNT
telemetry.description: Count for the number of times the MCLK in REU-B has been synched with SCLK autonomously.

telemetry.name: TIME_MCLK_A_AUTO_SYNC_ENABLED
telemetry.description: State of the autonomous synchronization (to SCLK) mode for the MCLK in REU-A (true=enabled / false=disabled).

telemetry.name: TIME_MCLK_B_AUTO_SYNC_ENABLED
telemetry.description: State of the autonomous synchronization (to SCLK) mode for the MCLK in REU-B (true=enabled / false=disabled).

telemetry.name: TIME_MCLK_A_SCLK_DIFF
telemetry.description: The absolute time difference between SCLK and MCLK in REU-A. This is what the FSW calculates and uses to monitor for autonomous synchronization (if enabled).

telemetry.name: TIME_MCLK_B_SCLK_DIFF
telemetry.description: The absolute time difference between SCLK and MCLK in REU-B. This is what the FSW calculates and uses to monitor for autonomous synchronization (if enabled).

telemetry.name: TIME_SAVED_SCLK
telemetry.description: The SCLK seconds value periodically saved to shared memory.

telemetry.name: TIME_SCLK_IN_STM
telemetry.description: SCLK seconds value in STM sent across 1553.

telemetry.name: UPL_MGR_ATIF_AUTO_SEL_STATUS
telemetry.description: Uplink hardware auto select status

telemetry.name: UPL_MGR_NUM_HCD_BUFF_OVRRUN_ERR
telemetry.description: The number of uplink HCD overrun errors. This value is set to 0 on reboot

telemetry.name: UPL_MGR_NUM_DMA_BUFF_OVRRUN_ERR
telemetry.description: The number of uplink DMA overrun errors. This value is set to 0 on reboot.

telemetry.name: UPL_MGR_NUM_DMA_ERR
telemetry.description: The number of uplink DMA errors. This value is set to 0 on reboot.

telemetry.name: UPL_MGR_NUM_LOSS_OF_LOCK_IN_DECODE
telemetry.description: The number of uplink loss-of-lock while in decode detections. This value is set to 0 on reboot.

telemetry.name: UPL_MGR_NUM_LCKCNT_ROLLOVRS
telemetry.description: The number of times the uplink lock count counter has reached its threshold and rolled over. This value is set to 0 on reboot.

telemetry.name: UPL_MGR_NUM_VALID_VC0_FRMS
telemetry.description: The number of VC-0 command frames received. This value is set to 0 on reboot.

telemetry.name: UPL_MGR_NUM_VALID_VC1_FRMS
telemetry.description: The number of VC-1 command frames received. This value is set to 0 on reboot.

telemetry.name: UPL_MGR_NUM_VALID_VC3_FRMS
telemetry.description: The number of VC-3 command frames received. This value is set to 0 on reboot.

telemetry.name: UPL_MGR_NUM_VALID_VC5_FRMS
telemetry.description: The number of VC-5 command frames received. This value is set to 0 on reboot.

telemetry.name: UPL_MGR_NUM_INVALID_VC0_FRMS
telemetry.description: The number of invalid VC-0 command frames received. This value is set to 0 on reboot.

telemetry.name: UPL_MGR_NUM_INVALID_VC1_FRMS
telemetry.description: The number of invalid VC-1 command frames received. This value is set to 0 on reboot.

telemetry.name: UPL_MGR_NUM_INVALID_VC3_FRMS
telemetry.description: The number of invalid VC-3 command frames received. This value is set to 0 on reboot.

telemetry.name: UPL_MGR_NUM_INVALID_VC5_FRMS
telemetry.description: The number of invalid VC-5 command frames received. This value is set to 0 on reboot.

telemetry.name: UPL_MGR_NUM_UNK_VCID_FRMS
telemetry.description: The number of frames received with an unknown VC_ID . This value is set to 0 on reboot.

telemetry.name: UPL_MGR_HCD_UNCORR_ERRS_CNT
telemetry.description: The number of unexpected HCD uncorrectable errors (i.e. errors in frames that are not tail sequences). This value is set to 0 on reboot.

telemetry.name: UPL_MGR_NUM_HCD_CORR_ERRS
telemetry.description: The number of HCD correctable errors. This value is set to 0 on reboot.

telemetry.name: UPL_MGR_NUM_INVALID_HW_CMDS_HCD
telemetry.description: The number of invalid hardware (VC-0) commands detected by the HCD. This value is set to 0 on reboot.

telemetry.name: UPL_MGR_FRM_1ST_6BITS_ERR_CNT
telemetry.description: The number of times an error is detected in the first 6 bits of the uplink transfer frame header (frame header version, bypass, command control, reserved spares). This value is set to 0 on reboot.

telemetry.name: UPL_MGR_NUM_FRMS_INVALID_LENGTH
telemetry.description: The number of transfer frames that failed validation due to frame length errors. This value is set to 0 on reboot.

telemetry.name: UPL_MGR_NUM_FRMS_INVALID_ORDER
telemetry.description: The number of transfer frames that failed validation due to out-of-order errors. This value is set to 0 on reboot.

telemetry.name: UPL_MGR_NUM_FRMS_INVALID_SCID
telemetry.description: The number of transfer frames that failed validation due to an invalid spacecraft ID. This value is set to 0 on reboot.

telemetry.name: UPL_MGR_NUM_FRMS_INVALID_STRINGID
telemetry.description: The number of transfer frames that failed validation due to an invalid string ID. This value is set to 0 on reboot.

telemetry.name: UPL_MGR_NUM_FRMS_INVALID_FECW
telemetry.description: The number of transfer frames that failed validation due to frame error control word (FECW) errors. This value is set to 0 on reboot.

telemetry.name: UPL_MGR_NUM_VALID_UPLINK_SESS
telemetry.description: The number of valid uplink sessions. This value is set to 0 on reboot.

telemetry.name: UPL_MGR_NUM_REJECTED_UPLINK_SESS
telemetry.description: The number of rejected uplink sessions. This value is set to 0 on reboot.

telemetry.name: UPL_MGR_CURRENT_STRING
telemetry.description: The current hardware string that FSW is operating on.

telemetry.name: UPL_MGR_CURRENT_CHAN_SOURCE
telemetry.description: The current uplink channel source used by FSW.

telemetry.name: UPL_MGR_CURRENT_VCID
telemetry.description: The current VC-ID received and processed by uplink.

telemetry.name: UPL_MGR_CURRENT_EDAC_CONFIG
telemetry.description: The current EDAC mode used by the HCD. FSW reads the EIO register ulcfg bit 15 (which is controlled by CRC02) when an uplink is processed. Therefore, an additional command (e.g. CMD_NO_OP) is needed before this channel updates.

telemetry.name: UPL_MGR_CURRENT_HW_SCID
telemetry.description: The current spacecraft ID set in the hardware.

telemetry.name: UPL_MGR_CURRENT_STATE
telemetry.description: The current state of UPLMGR.

telemetry.name: UPL_MGR_NUM_ACQ_SEQ_NON_SEL_UPL_MGR_SRC
telemetry.description: The number of acquisition sequences detected on a non-selected uplink source. This value is set to 0 on reboot.

telemetry.name: UPL_MGR_NUM_LOCKS_RSDST
telemetry.description: The number of locks detected on the RSDST uplink source. This value is set to 0 on reboot.

telemetry.name: UPL_MGR_NUM_LOCKS_DSDST
telemetry.description: The number of locks detected on the DSDST uplink source. This value is set to 0 on reboot.

telemetry.name: UPL_MGR_NUM_FRAMES_VAL_FAIL
telemetry.description: The total number of uplink frames that have failed validation. This value is set to 0 on reboot.

telemetry.name: UPL_MGR_ECHO_DP_FRM_ERR_CNT
telemetry.description: The current value of the uplink frame error counter associated with the uplink echo DP.

telemetry.name: UPL_MGR_ECHO_DP_VALID_FRM_CNT
telemetry.description: The current value of the consecutive valid uplink frame counter associated with the uplink echo DP.

telemetry.name: UPL_MGR_ATIF_LCKCNT_REGISTER
telemetry.description: The current value of the ATIF lock count register.

telemetry.name: UPL_MGR_DMA_PARITY_ERR_CNT
telemetry.description: The number of DMA parity errors reported by the hardware. This value is set to 0 on reboot.

telemetry.name: UPL_MGR_NUM_DATA_NO_INTRPT
telemetry.description: The number of instances where uplink data was received, but no DMA status bits were set. This is indicative of a DMA failure.

telemetry.name: UPL_MGR_ILLEGAL_COMMAND_CNT
telemetry.description: The number of occurrences of an illegal combination of string IDs during product validation. This value is set to 0 on reboot.

telemetry.name: UPL_MGR_SESSION_VCID_CHNG_CNT
telemetry.description: The number of VC-IDs changes during an uplink session.

telemetry.name: UPL_MGR_NUM_NO_ACTIVE_DMA
telemetry.description: The number of non-active DMAs for uplink.

telemetry.name: UPL_MGR_NUM_BOTH_DMA_ACTIVE
telemetry.description: The number of instances where both DMAs are active.

telemetry.name: UPL_MGR_NUM_ACQ_SEQ_NON_SEL_UPL_MGR_SRC_SW

telemetry.name: UPL_MGR_FRAME_SRC_MISMATCH_CNT

telemetry.name: UPL_CFDP_TOTAL_SUCCESSFUL_TRANSACTIONS
telemetry.description: This channel contains the number of successfully completed CFDP uplink transactions.

telemetry.name: UPL_CFDP_TOTAL_FAILED_TRANSACTIONS

telemetry.name: UPL_CFDP_LAST_TRANSACTION_SUCCESSFUL_TSN
telemetry.description: This channel contains the transaction sequence number (TSN) of the last CFDP uplink transaction that finished with no error.

telemetry.name: UPL_CFDP_LAST_TRANSACTION_SUCCESSFUL_TIMESTAMP

telemetry.name: UPL_CFDP_LAST_TRANSACTION_FAILED_FILENAME_0

telemetry.name: UPL_CFDP_LAST_TRANSACTION_FAILED_TSN

telemetry.name: UPL_CFDP_TEMP_STORAGE_BYTES_AVAILABLE

telemetry.name: UPL_CFDP_NUM_FIN_PDUS_SENT

telemetry.name: UPL_CFDP_NUM_ACK_PDUS_SENT

telemetry.name: UPL_CFDP_NUM_NAK_PDUS_SENT
telemetry.description: This channel contains the number of NAK PDUS sent in response to CFDP uplink transactions.

telemetry.name: UPL_CFDP_NUM_METADATA_PDUS_ACCEPTED
telemetry.description: This channel contains the number of METADATA PDUS accepted as part of CFDP uplink transactions.

telemetry.name: UPL_CFDP_NUM_DATA_PDUS_ACCEPTED
telemetry.description: This channel contains the number of DATA PDUS accepted as part of CFDP uplink transactions.

telemetry.name: UPL_CFDP_NUM_ACKFIN_PDUS_ACCEPTED
telemetry.description: This channel contains the number of ACKFIN PDUS accepted as part of CFDP uplink transactions.

telemetry.name: UPL_CFDP_NUM_EOF_PDUS_ACCEPTED
telemetry.description: This channel contains the number of EOF PDUS accepted as part of CFDP uplink transactions.

telemetry.name: UPL_CFDP_NUM_METADATA_PDUS_RJCTD
telemetry.description: This channel contains the number of METADATA PDUS rejected as part of CFDP uplink transactions.

telemetry.name: UPL_CFDP_NUM_DATA_PDUS_RJCTD
telemetry.description: This channel contains the number of DATA PDUS rejected as part of CFDP uplink transactions.

telemetry.name: UPL_CFDP_NUM_EOF_PDUS_RJCTD
telemetry.description: This channel contains the number of ACKFIN PDUS rejected as part of CFDP uplink transactions.

telemetry.name: UPL_CFDP_NUM_ACKFIN_PDUS_RJCTD
telemetry.description: This channel contains the number of EOF PDUS rejected as part of CFDP uplink transactions.

telemetry.name: UPL_CFDP_NUM_UNKNOWN_PDUS_RJCTD
telemetry.description: This channel contains the number of UNKNOWN PDUS rejected as part of CFDP uplink transactions.

telemetry.name: UPL_CFDP_ERR_POS_ACK_LMT_REACHED
telemetry.description: This channel contains the number of times the positive ACK limit was reached for CFDP uplink transactions.

telemetry.name: UPL_CFDP_ERR_INVALID_TRANSM_MODE
telemetry.description: This channel contains the number of times an invalid transmission mode was detected for CFDP uplink transactions.

telemetry.name: UPL_CFDP_ERR_FILESTORE_REJECTION
telemetry.description: This channel contains the number of times a filestore rejection occurred for CFDP uplink transactions.

telemetry.name: UPL_CFDP_ERR_FILE_CHECKSUM_FAIL
telemetry.description: This channel contains the number of times a file checksum check failed for CFDP uplink transactions.

telemetry.name: UPL_CFDP_ERR_FILE_SIZE_ERROR
telemetry.description: This channel contains the number of times a file size error occurred for CFDP uplink transactions.

telemetry.name: UPL_CFDP_ERR_NAK_LMT_REACHED
telemetry.description: This channel contains the number of times a CFDP uplink transaction encountered its NAK limit.

telemetry.name: UPL_CFDP_ERR_INACTIVITY_DETECTED
telemetry.description: This channel contains the number of times a CFDP uplink transaction encountered inactivity limit.

telemetry.name: UPL_CFDP_FREEZE_THAW_TIMER_STATUS
telemetry.description: This channel contains the state of the freeze thaw timer for CFDP Uplink.

telemetry.name: UPL_CFDP_LAST_ACTIVE_TRANSACTION_TSN
telemetry.description: The TSN of the last active transaction (active transaction is one where a Data PDU, MPDU or EPDU has just been received)

telemetry.name: UPL_CFDP_LAST_ACTIVE_TRANSACTION_MPDU_FILESIZE
telemetry.description: The specified file size, in the MPDU, of the last active transaction (active transaction is one where a Data PDU, MPDU or EPDU has just been received).

telemetry.name: UPL_CFDP_LAST_ACTIVE_TRANSACTION_OVERWRITE_FLAG
telemetry.description: The value of the overwrite flag of the last active transaction (active transaction is one where a Data PDU, MPDU or EPDU has just been received).

telemetry.name: UPL_CFDP_LAST_ACTIVE_TRANSACTION_LAST_PDU_TYPE
telemetry.description: The type of the last PDU received of the last active transaction (active transaction is one where a Data PDU, MPDU or EPDU has just been received).

telemetry.name: UPL_CFDP_LAST_ACTIVE_TRANSACTION_DATA_OFFSET
telemetry.description: The Data Offset of the last PDU received of the last active transaction (active transaction is one where a Data PDU, MPDU or EPDU has just been received).

telemetry.name: UPL_CFDP_LAST_ACTIVE_TRANSACTION_PHASE
telemetry.description: The uplink phase (e.g. "fill gaps") of the last active transaction (active transaction is one where a Data PDU, MPDU or EPDU has just been received).

telemetry.name: UPL_CFDP_LAST_ACTIVE_TRANSACTION_CANCELLED_STATUS
telemetry.description: The cancelled status of the last active transaction (active transaction is one where a Data PDU, MPDU or EPDU has just been received).

telemetry.name: UPL_CFDP_LAST_ACTIVE_TRANSACTION_ACK_COUNT
telemetry.description: The number of times the ACK timer has expired for the last active transaction (active transaction is one where a Data PDU, MPDU or EPDU has just been received).

telemetry.name: UPL_CFDP_LAST_ACTIVE_TRANSACTION_NAK_COUNT
telemetry.description: The number of times the NAK timer has expired for the last active transaction (active transaction is one where a Data PDU, MPDU or EPDU has just been received)

telemetry.name: UPL_CFDP_LAST_ACTIVE_TRANSACTION_INACTIVITY_EXPIR_TIME
telemetry.description: The time, in seconds, when the inactivity timer is set to expire in the last active transaction (active transaction is one where a Data PDU, MPDU or EPDU has just been received).

telemetry.name: UPL_CFDP_LAST_ACTIVE_TRANSACTION_NUM_NAK_SGMNT_REQUESTS
telemetry.description: The number of segments requested in the NAK associated with the last active transaction (active transaction is one where a Data PDU, MPDU or EPDU has just been received).

telemetry.name: UPL_CFDP_LAST_ACTIVE_TRANSACTION_FIRST_NAK_SEGMENT_START
telemetry.description: The start address of the first NAK segment requested by the last active transaction (active transaction is one where a Data PDU, MPDU or EPDU has just been received).

telemetry.name: UPL_CFDP_LAST_ACTIVE_TRANSACTION_FIRST_NAK_SEGMENT_END
telemetry.description: The end address of the first NAK segment requested by the last active transaction (active transaction is one where a Data PDU, MPDU or EPDU has just been received).

telemetry.name: UPL_CFDP_LAST_ACTIVE_TRANSACTION_LAST_NAK_SEGMENT_START
telemetry.description: The start address of the last NAK segment requested by the last active transaction (active transaction is one where a Data PDU, MPDU or EPDU has just been received).

telemetry.name: UPL_CFDP_LAST_ACTIVE_TRANSACTION_LAST_NAK_SEGMENT_END
telemetry.description: The end address of the last NAK segment requested by the last active transaction (active transaction is one where a Data PDU, MPDU or EPDU has just been received).

telemetry.name: UPL_CFDP_NUM_DROPPED_PDUS
telemetry.description: Counts the number of PDUs dropped by CFDP because FSW could not process them quickly enough.

telemetry.name: UPL_CFDP_LAST_TRANSACTION_FAILED_TIMESTAMP
telemetry.description: This channel contains the time (in coarse SCLK) when the last failed transaction completed.

telemetry.name: UPL_CFDP_ERR_CANCL_UNK_TRANS
telemetry.description: This channel contains the number of times A CANCEL request was received to an unknown or previously invalidated transaction.

telemetry.name: UPL_FVS_NUM_FILE_LOADS_RECV
telemetry.description: Total number of files received (regardless if failed for any reason or not).

telemetry.name: UPL_FVS_NUM_FILES_FAIL_GEN_VAL
telemetry.description: Total number of files rejected because they failed generic file verification.

telemetry.name: UPL_FVS_NUM_FILES_OVERWRITTEN
telemetry.description: Total number of files overwritten (per overwrite flag).

telemetry.name: UPL_FVS_NUM_FILES_SAVED_ONBOARD
telemetry.description: Total number of files saved to non-volatile filesystem (or volatile filesystem if in zombie mode).

telemetry.name: UPL_CFDP_LAST_TRANSACTION_SUCCESSFUL_FILENAME_1
telemetry.description: This channel contains characters 41-80 of the filename (including path) of the file associated with the last CFDP uplink transaction that finished with no error.

telemetry.name: UPL_CFDP_LAST_TRANSACTION_SUCCESSFUL_FILENAME_2
telemetry.description: This channel contains characters 81-120 of the filename (including path) of the file associated with the last CFDP uplink transaction that finished with no error.

telemetry.name: UPL_CFDP_LAST_TRANSACTION_SUCCESSFUL_FILENAME_3
telemetry.description: This channel contains characters 121-128 of the filename (including path) of the file associated with the last CFDP uplink transaction that finished with no error.

telemetry.name: UPL_CFDP_LAST_TRANSACTION_FAILED_FILENAME_1
telemetry.description: This channel contains characters 41-80 of the filename (including path) of the file associated with the last CFDP uplink transaction that failed.

telemetry.name: UPL_CFDP_LAST_TRANSACTION_FAILED_FILENAME_2
telemetry.description: This channel contains characters 81-120 of the filename (including path) of the file associated with the last CFDP uplink transaction that failed.

telemetry.name: UPL_CFDP_LAST_TRANSACTION_FAILED_FILENAME_3
telemetry.description: This channel contains characters 121-128 of the filename (including path) of the file associated with the last CFDP uplink transaction that failed.

telemetry.name: UVS_OP_STATUS
telemetry.description: Consists of the Operational Status bits in the UVS H&S packet. Includes the number of subseconds that have elapsed since the last time sync signal was received, Interface Type, Selected Interface, Busy bit, Panic bit, and Instrument Mode.

telemetry.name: UVS_CMD_STATUS
telemetry.description: Consists of the Command Status bits in the UVS H&S packet. Includes command accepted overflow, command accepted counter, command executed overflow, command executed counter, command rejected overflow, and command rejected counter.

telemetry.name: UVS_CMD_HIST_0
telemetry.description: Consists of the history of the last Command in the UVS H&S packet. This includes: Least significant five bits of sequence count of the last received command (5-bit) Command status code of last received command (3-bit) Opcode of last command (16-bit integer)

telemetry.name: UVS_CMD_HIST_1
telemetry.description: Consists of the history of the second to last Command in the UVS H&S packet. This includes: Least significant five bits of sequence count of the second to last received command (5-bit) Command status code of the second to last received command (3-bit) Opcode of the second to last command (16-bit integer)

telemetry.name: UVS_CMD_HIST_2
telemetry.description: Consists of the history of the third to last Command in the UVS H&S packet. This includes: Least significant five bits of sequence count of the third to last received command (5-bit) Command status code of the third to last received command (3-bit) Opcode of the third to last command (16-bit integer)

telemetry.name: UVS_CMD_HIST_3
telemetry.description: Consists of the history of the fourth to last Command in the UVS H&S packet. This includes: Least significant five bits of sequence count of the fourth to last received command (5-bit) Command status code of the fourth to last received command (3-bit) Opcode of the fourth to last command (16-bit integer)

telemetry.name: UVS_CMD_HIST_4
telemetry.description: Consists of the history of the fifth to last Command in the UVS H&S packet. This includes: Least significant five bits of sequence count of the fifth to last received command (5-bit) Command status code of the fifth to last received command (3-bit) Opcode of the fifth to last command (16-bit integer)

telemetry.name: UVS_SPW_STATUS
telemetry.description: Consists of the UVS SpaceWire Error Count in the UVS H&S packet.

telemetry.name: UVS_GEN_STATUS_0
telemetry.description: Includes safety state, last active safety, and flags for HV Power activated, Telem. Overflow, Command Overflow, Routing, Cmd received, Time Sync Msg received, Time SpW Sync pulse received, Critical cmd pending

telemetry.name: UVS_GEN_STATUS_1
telemetry.description: Includes status on: WPA actuator driven, Detector electronics powered, OAP Heater Powered, Grating Heater Powered, SOC Heater Powered, Detector Door Position, AP Door Position, HP Door Position, WPA SW Active, HV Safe Plug, RA Plug, NRA Plug, SP Door Position, and Event Code.

telemetry.name: UVS_LAST_EVENT_TIMEHACK
telemetry.description: Timehack value of the last event

telemetry.name: UVS_TMTC_LAST_COMMAND
telemetry.description: Includes Last Cmd Accepted, Last Cmd Rejected.

telemetry.name: UVS_TMTC_REPORTING
telemetry.description: Includes the H&S Reporting period, number of time messages received and accepted, and number of SpW time codes received and accepted.

telemetry.name: UVS_ADP_PKT_COUNTER
telemetry.description: The number of ADP packets generated.

telemetry.name: UVS_MEM_PKT_COUNTER
telemetry.description: Memory dump packets generated (packet counter).

telemetry.name: UVS_SCI_PIX_PKT_COUNTER
telemetry.description: Science pixellist packets generated (packet counter).

telemetry.name: UVS_SCI_HIST_PKT_COUNTER
telemetry.description: Science histogram packets generated (packet counter).

telemetry.name: UVS_SCI_COUNTRATE_PKT_COUNTER
telemetry.description: Science countrate packets generated (packet counter).

telemetry.name: UVS_CRITICAL_TIMEOUT
telemetry.description: Remaining critical command timeout

telemetry.name: UVS_ACQ_STATUS
telemetry.description: Includes flags for Test Generator activated, HV Limited to reduced level, Hot pixelmasking activated, Science overflow occurred, Active acquisition memory side, DetStim Active, and Countrate telemetry active

telemetry.name: UVS_TIMEHACK
telemetry.description: Hack time in milliseconds (range 49 days).

telemetry.name: UVS_SCI_AID
telemetry.description: AID used in science telemetry (from acquisition command).

telemetry.name: UVS_HACK_RATE
telemetry.description: Hack period in milliseconds; 1-255 milliseconds.

telemetry.name: UVS_MEM_POINTER
telemetry.description: Acquisition memory pointer (in bytes).

telemetry.name: UVS_FRAME_COUNTER
telemetry.description: Frames generated since power on.

telemetry.name: UVS_ANALOG_COUNTER
telemetry.description: Analog event counter.

telemetry.name: UVS_ANALOG_COUNTRATE
telemetry.description: Max and Min Analog Countrates. Units of events per 100 milliseconds.

telemetry.name: UVS_DIGITAL_COUNTER
telemetry.description: Digital event counter.

telemetry.name: UVS_DIGITAL_COUNTRATE
telemetry.description: Max and min digital countrate. Units of events per 100 milliseconds.

telemetry.name: UVS_MASKED_COUNTER
telemetry.description: Masked event counter.

telemetry.name: UVS_DISCRIMINATORS
telemetry.description: Lower and Upper Discriminators.

telemetry.name: UVS_ACQ_TIMEOUT
telemetry.description: Acquisition timeout, time remaining in current acquisition (in seconds, zero if no timeout set or timeout expired).

telemetry.name: UVS_HVPS_STATUS_0
telemetry.description: Includes commanded HV setpoint, remaining HV limit timeout (seconds), and max and min Mcp voltage.

telemetry.name: UVS_HVPS_STATUS_1
telemetry.description: Includes max and min anode voltage, Max and min strip current.

telemetry.name: UVS_TEMP_SETPOINTS
telemetry.description: Includes OAP mirror, grating, and pickoff mirror setpoint temperatures.

telemetry.name: UVS_TEMPERATURES_0
telemetry.description: Includes primary and secondary readings for OAP mirror and grating temperatures.

telemetry.name: UVS_TEMPERATURES_1
telemetry.description: Includes solar port mirror, C&DH, HVPS, and LVPS temperatures.

telemetry.name: UVS_RADFET_TEMP
telemetry.description: Temperature of the RadFET installed on the UVS HVPS board

telemetry.name: UVS_TEMPERATURES_2
telemetry.description: Includes solar port, detector body, DETE, and chassis temperatures.

telemetry.name: UVS_SAFETY_STATUS_0
telemetry.description: Includes the number of remaining HV limit cycles, safety detected flags for bus current, temperature, cycle, anode voltage, strip current, high voltage, and bright object.

telemetry.name: UVS_SAFETY_STATUS_1
telemetry.description: Includes the unsafe timer period, safety override flag, and safety mask flags for bus current, temperature, cycle, anode voltage, strip current, high voltage, and bright object.

telemetry.name: UVS_RADFET_DATA
telemetry.description: Includes the value reading and offset reading of the RadFET installed on the UVS HVPS board.

telemetry.name: UVS_6P1V_STATUS
telemetry.description: Includes internal monitors for +/-6.1 volt and associated current.

telemetry.name: UVS_3P3V_STATUS
telemetry.description: Includes internal monitors for +3.3 volt and associated current.

telemetry.name: UVS_LOW_VOLT_STATUS
telemetry.description: Includes +1.8 V and +1.5 V monitors, and analog ground level.

telemetry.name: UVS_DIAG_DATA_0
telemetry.description: Includes number of cycles through the idle task per second, number of scheduler calls per second, number of completed RAM scrubber cycles, and first deleted task OR debug selector (depends on value of that byte).

telemetry.name: UVS_DIAG_DATA_1
telemetry.description: Includes stack pointer of tasks 1-4 out of 10 or selected debug information.

telemetry.name: UVS_DIAG_DATA_2
telemetry.description: Includes stack pointer of tasks 5-8 out of 10 or selected debug information.

telemetry.name: UVS_DIAG_DATA_3
telemetry.description: Includes stack pointer of tasks 9-10 out of 10 or selected debug information, and the minimum reported free stack.

telemetry.name: UVS_DIAG_DATA_4
telemetry.description: Includes the currently executing code, hardware version, major and minor software version, and FPGA version.

telemetry.name: UVS_DIAG_DATA_5
telemetry.description: Includes the number of EDAC recoveries and failures.

telemetry.name: UVS_DIAG_DATA_6
telemetry.description: Address of the last EDAC error (correctable or uncorrectable).

telemetry.name: UVS_DIAG_DATA_7
telemetry.description: Includes slow task activity, watchdog counter maxed out, watchdog expired counter, and result of last memory check operation.

telemetry.name: UVS_PARAMETER_DATA
telemetry.description: Includes the reported parameter index and value.

telemetry.name: UVS_EXPECTED_MODE
telemetry.description: The expected mode of UVS, as set by FSW.

telemetry.name: UVS_RESERVE_CHANNELS
telemetry.description: Reference voltage for onboard ADCs and 8-bit spare field

telemetry.name: UVS_ADP_METADATA_PKT_COUNT
telemetry.description: The number of ADP metadata packets received by FSW from UVS since ECE power on. Rolls over back to zero, no overflow bits.

telemetry.name: UVS_SUBSECONDS
telemetry.description: Sub-seconds value of the instrument clock prior to zeroing on receipt of the SpW Time-Code

telemetry.name: UVS_INTERFACE_TYPE
telemetry.description: UART or SPW. Always equal to SpW for UVS

telemetry.name: UVS_SELECTED_INTERFACE
telemetry.description: SpW side A or B

telemetry.name: UVS_BUSY_FLAG
telemetry.description: Unused for UVS and always equal to 0

telemetry.name: UVS_HELP_PANIC
telemetry.description: Flag indicating if UVS power off requested

telemetry.name: UVS_OPERATIONAL_STATE
telemetry.description: Instrument operational State (1-Checkout, 2-Safe, 3-Acquistion(His), 4-Acquisition(Pix), 5-Decon)

telemetry.name: UVS_CMD_ACCEPT_OVERFLOW_FLAG
telemetry.description: Overflow indicator for command accepted counter

telemetry.name: UVS_CMD_ACCEPT_COUNTER
telemetry.description: Command accepted counter; increments if command is accepted

telemetry.name: UVS_CMD_EXEC_OVERFLOW_FLAG
telemetry.description: Overflow indicator for command executed counter

telemetry.name: UVS_CMD_EXEC_COUNTER
telemetry.description: Command executed counter; increments if command is executed

telemetry.name: UVS_CMD_REJECT_OVERFLOW_FLAG
telemetry.description: Overflow indicator for command rejected counter

telemetry.name: UVS_CMD_REJECT_COUNTER
telemetry.description: Command rejected counter; increments if command is rejected

telemetry.name: UVS_CMD_SEQ_COUNT_0
telemetry.description: Least significant five bits of sequence count of the last received command

telemetry.name: UVS_CMD_STATUS_CODE_0
telemetry.description: Command status code of last received command

telemetry.name: UVS_CMD_OPCODE_0
telemetry.description: Opcode of last received command.

telemetry.name: UVS_CMD_SEQ_COUNT_1
telemetry.description: Least significant five bits of sequence count of the second to last received command

telemetry.name: UVS_CMD_STATUS_CODE_1
telemetry.description: Command status code of the second to last received command

telemetry.name: UVS_CMD_OPCODE_1
telemetry.description: Opcode of the second to last received command

telemetry.name: UVS_CMD_SEQ_COUNT_2
telemetry.description: Least significant five bits of sequence count of the third to last received command

telemetry.name: UVS_CMD_STATUS_CODE_2
telemetry.description: Command status code of the third to last received command

telemetry.name: UVS_CMD_OPCODE_2
telemetry.description: Opcode of the third to last received command

telemetry.name: UVS_CMD_SEQ_COUNT_3
telemetry.description: Least significant five bits of sequence count of the fourth to last received command

telemetry.name: UVS_CMD_STATUS_CODE_3
telemetry.description: Command status code of the fourth to last received command

telemetry.name: UVS_CMD_OPCODE_3
telemetry.description: Opcode of the fourth to last received command

telemetry.name: UVS_CMD_SEQ_COUNT_4
telemetry.description: Least significant five bits of sequence count of the fifth to last received command

telemetry.name: UVS_CMD_STATUS_CODE_4
telemetry.description: Command status code of the fifth to last received command

telemetry.name: UVS_CMD_OPCODE_4
telemetry.description: Opcode of the fifth to last received command

telemetry.name: UVS_SPW_ERROR_COUNT_OVERFLOW_FLAG
telemetry.description: Overflow indicator for SpW error counter

telemetry.name: UVS_SPW_ERROR_COUNTER

telemetry.name: UVS_SAFETY_ACTIVE_FLAG

telemetry.name: UVS_LAST_SAFETY

telemetry.name: UVS_HV_PWR_FLAG

telemetry.name: UVS_DET_PWR_FLAG

telemetry.name: UVS_OAP_HTR_PWR_FLAG

telemetry.name: UVS_GRA_HTR_PWR_FLAG
telemetry.description: Flag to indicate if the Grating heater is powered on

telemetry.name: UVS_SOC_HTR_PWR_FLAG

telemetry.name: UVS_DET_DOOR_POS_STATUS

telemetry.name: UVS_AP_DOOR_POS_STATUS

telemetry.name: UVS_HP_DOOR_POS_STATUS
telemetry.description: HP Door Position Status (0-Between, 1-Close, 2-Open, 3-Fail)

telemetry.name: UVS_WPA_SW_ACTIVE_STATUS

telemetry.name: UVS_HV_SAFE_PLUG_FLAG

telemetry.name: UVS_RA_PLUG_FLAG

telemetry.name: UVS_NRA_PLUG_FLAG

telemetry.name: UVS_SP_DOOR_POS_STATUS

telemetry.name: UVS_EVENT_CODE
telemetry.description: This is a rotating 5-element buffer of events. The H&S packet cycles through the events in order from the most to the least recent. When a new event/error is created, the next (recorded) H&S packet will start over with this most recent event. Note that the values cycle at the rate of the recorded H&S packet period.

telemetry.name: UVS_LAST_CMD_ACCEPT

telemetry.name: UVS_LAST_CMD_REJECT

telemetry.name: UVS_HS_PACKET_REPORT_PERIOD
